If false, only those first 3 (so not the primary) would have gotten webbed

If the var then goes to "Consumed" the holding will be set to the consumed state. If the var goes to "Untouched" the holding will be put back into its normal starting state. If the var is set to anything else from Exposed, the holding will be set to the "Lost" state. Manually setting any of these states always works, regardless of the holding's current state. Also see the two additional ConsumedLingering and LostLingering ExposableHoldingState for tuning visuals

If it's set to anything else, we'll wait until it changes to one or the other before doing either the fulgurite or normal death sequence

Also, the raymarching can be finished earlier so that it can earn some performance. But, using extremely high value like 10.0 can cause the banding and hard edge artifacts. This option highly impacts the performance.

CloudRadius.description: How large should the cloud be?

CloudTopOffset.description: It determines the offset where can be skewed by wind direction.

CloudTotalLifetime.description: How long after spawning should the cloud deactivate itself?

If the final type value is getting close to 1.0, it may need higher Min/Max Sample Count to render the clouds. This option highly impacts the performance.

DesiredShadowState.description:
Should we always cast shadows, never cast shadows, or dissolve shadows normally using the pre-shader?
Whether or not shadows are cast is based on these rules:

1. If a shader wants to disable shadows completely, shadows will be disabled regardless of the other shaders' values.

2. If no shader wants shadows disabled completely, but a shader wants to always cast shadows, complete shadows will be cast.

3. Finally, if no shader wants shadows to always be enabled or disabled, shadows will dissolve normally using the preshader transparency.

DistFastY.description: Distance to use our maximum tracking gain

DistForFarAccuracy.description: If the target is at this distance or farther, we use the far inner/outer accuracy values. Otherwise blend between them and the near values.

DistForMax.description: Maximum distance for computing interpolation value

DistForMaxArc.description: When the target is this far away, we use MaxArcHeight

DistForMaxOcclusion.description: At what distance from the hero does the target create the widest occlusion shape

DistForMaxPush.description: Distance at which we apply maximum pushing strength

DistForMaxRange.description: Distance at which we use maximal values

DistForMin.description: Minimum distance for computing interpolation value

DistForMinArc.description: When the target is this far away, we don't use any arc

DistForMinOcclusion.description: At what distance from the hero does the target create the narrowest occlusion shape

DistForMinPush.description: Distance from the pivot to the camera at which we can start pushing the participants away from the wall

DistForMinRange.description: Distance at which we use minimal values

DistForNearAccuracy.description: If the target is at this distance or nearer, we use the near inner/outer accuracy values. Otherwise blend between them and the far values.

DistFromCamera.description: The distance from the camera to place the UI.

DistFromGroundToStayInAir.description: If we get within this distance to the ground, we'll drop to the ground. Otherwise we'll let the move slide in the air

DistFromTarget.description: If the target is this far away or more then we will try teleporting.

DistInvisMax.description: We take AcquireTimeMax to acquire an invisible spotted target at this distance (m)

DistInvisMin.description: We take AcquireTimeMin to acquire an invisible spotted target at this distance (m)

DistMax.description: We take AcquireTimeMax to acquire a spotted target at this distance (m)

DistMin.description: We instantly acquire a spotted target at this distance (m)
DistMin.label: Dist Min

DistMult.description: Distance to the destination is multiplied by this value when determining speed
DistMult.label: Distance Multiplier

DistSelfScoringWeight.description: Distance from bot weight applied to find best point

DistSlowXZ.description: Distance to use our minimum tracking gain

DistSlowY.description: Distance to use our minimum tracking gain

DistTargetScoringWeight.description: Distance from partner weight applied to find best point

DistTargetYScoringWeight.description: Y distance from partner weight apllied to find best point. Important if there is an issue with the bot and ground of different height

DistToDelete.description: Critters are spawned, so as a failsafe we will delete them when they aren't being drawn and are at a distance greater than this value.
DistToDelete.label: Distance to Delete At

DistToHeight.description: For every horizontal meter we're jumping our apex goes up by this. Tuning it down will probably cause clipping, so only increase it

DistToPOI.description: Enable this rule if given landmark type is the nearest POI and within DistToPOI meters

DistToReset.description: If the player moves more then this far along a grind it will count as moving and reset the amount of time until scabs can hit you.

Distance.description: The farthest an actor can be from the trigger to use it.
Distance.label: Total Charge Distance

DistanceAbove.description: How far above target should we zip to.

DistanceAdd.description: Additive applied to the perceived distance of the target when picking the best target. Bias gets phased out depending for depending on how likely the stick input is trying to pick this target

DistanceAdded.description: Flat distance value added to bots in this zone

DistanceBetweenBloopDrops.description: Blood trail is made by blood drops and a drop will at minimum be this distance apart

DistanceFactor.description: How much distance from the hero factors into the critter spawn location selection.

DistanceFar.description: Far distance at which to apply no scaling factor

DistanceForFullPhaseOut.description: When the camera distance gets less than this amount to the hero we apply the full phase out amount

Larger numbers tend to make angle rating more important since it decreases the falloff when lerping between MinAngleDistanceBiasXZ and MaxAngleDistanceBiasXZ

DistanceForMaxForce.description: Distance at which we apply the most force to the bots flyback reaction

DistanceForMaxSpeed.description: At this distance we will use our maximum speed values

DistanceForMinAngleBias.description: Distance at which we use the MinAngleDistanceBiasXZ for balancing distance to angle

DistanceForMinBias.description: Camera distance to start applying biasing

DistanceForMinForce.description: Distance at which we apply the least force to the bots flyback reaction

DistanceForMinSpeed.description: At this distance we will use our minimum speed values

DistanceFromAimLineMaxDist.description: At this distance we finish phasing out InnerAngleDistanceFromAimLine

DistanceFromAimLineMinDist.description: At this distance we start phasing out InnerAngleDistanceFromAimLine.

DistanceFromRequestStartToStartTrail.description: Distance from blood trail start request position hero needs to move before we actually start creating a blood trail

DistanceFromTarget.description: Rank the stealer as if they're this much farther from the target than they really are. This influences the final Range and Ideal Range priority
DistanceFromTarget.label: Distance From Target

DistanceFromUIPlane.description: The distance from the plane of the UI actor to the tutorial panel (in direction from desired location position to camera)

DistanceFullWobble.description: The wobble offset magnitude maxes out when aiming at a target this far away
DistanceFullWobble.label: Distance Full Wobble

DistanceHighlightOff.description: If the lizard is within this distance of the player and mostly visible, highlighting will turn off.

DistanceHighlightOn.description: If the lizard is further than this distance to the player, highlighting will turn on.

DistanceInMeters.description: The distance at which DistanceStrength takes full effect (0 = no distance-based modification)

DistanceInterpolationSpeed.description: How quickly distant rain moves to its destination

DistanceMax.description: Forced maximum travel distance if the damage uses a kinetic multiplier
DistanceMax.label: Distance Max

DistanceMult.description: Multiplier applied to the perceived distance of the target when picking the best target. Bias gets phased out depending for depending on how likely the stick input is trying to pick this target

DistanceMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to distance rating of bots above this zone

DistanceMultiplierBias.description: Multiplier applied to perceived distance to target. Values between [0,1] make them more favorable, with closer to 0 being the strongest

DistanceNear.description: Near distance at which to apply full scaling factor

DistanceNoWobble.description: Within this range, we don't wobble at all
DistanceNoWobble.label: Distance No Wobble

DistancePOIOff.description: If the lizard is within this distance of the player, the POI will turn off.

DistancePOIOn.description: If the lizard is further than this distance to the player, the POI will turn on.

DistancePercent.description: The percent that the distance difference factors into the hot-cold beeps (remaining percent is the combination of pitch/yaw).

DistancePowerCurve.description: Exponent applied to distance to help make things further away much harder to hit

DistanceRadii.description: How large each radius of the distance rain is

DistanceRainActor.description: The actor to use for distance rain

DistanceRange.description: How far we need to be from an event for it to fire
DistanceRange.label: Distance Range

DistanceSliceCount.description: Number of sections per ring to use for distance rain

DistanceSmoothing.description: How much smoothing to apply to distance values. 0=none 1=never changing

DistanceStrength.description: The strength of the SSAO effect in the distance

DistanceToBeginSyncDodge.description: Distance to begin the sync dodges

DistanceToGroundLocatorName.description: Locator from which to calculate Distance To Ground.

DistanceToGroundMaxDistance.description: The longest distance we measure with distance to ground

DistanceToGroundSmoothing.description: Factor to smooth DistanceToGround RTPC by. 1.f is full smoothing (no change) and 0.f is no smoothing.

DistanceToInstigator.description: Participant is at most this far from the instigator
DistanceToInstigator.label: Distance to Instigator

DistanceToPickup.description: Goto within this distance of the pickup before starting the yank and throw (negative means don't do a goto)
DistanceToPickup.label: Distance To Pickup

DistanceToPlayAmbientSound.description: How close the hero has to be from the slipstream for it to play ambient sound.

DistanceToStartPhaseOut.description: When the camera distance gets less than this amount to the hero we start phasing out how much FOV change we can apply

DistanceType.description: Controls what distance value to use
DistanceType.label: Distance Type

DistanceVarName.description: Animation driver variable name for Distance

DistanceWeight.description: A value for how much to weigh distance toward final score.

DistantLightingForceEmbedded.description: Samples in this volume will be treated as embedded and will not contribute to distant lighting.

DistantLightingGround.description: Base of volume will set the ground level for distant lighting calculations within the volume.

DistantLightingMid.description: Base of volume will set the mid level for distant lighting calculations within the volume.

DistantLightingRoof.description: Top of volume will set the roof level for distant lighting calculations within the volume.

DistantProxy.description: Selects whether light will be included in the hibernate system and a cheap approximation will be used after the fade out distance.
DistantProxy.label: Distant Proxy

DistractionGrenadesDisabled.description: Disable the ability for the bot to throw their Flashbangs at distraction objects

DistractionGrenadesEnabled.description: Enable the ability for the bot to throw their Flashbangs at distraction objects

District.description: This is the district that this data is valid in.
District.label: District

DistrictColorOverrides.description: Force specific color choices in specific districts. Must define ColorCount above.

DistrictName.description: If district(s) should be checked, this set will be enabled if there is a match on the district(s) selected here. No entries means that district will not be checked.

DistrictOverrides.description: Overrides for weight in specific districts only, if needed
DistrictOverrides.label: District Overrides

DistrictProgressWeight.description: Relative weight of doing one of these activities compared to other things in the district

DistrictProgressWeightOverride.description: Override weight for this group in this district only

DistrictProgressWeights.description: Data for how much district progress doing one of these items contributes.

Districts.description: If not empty, only gain progress from completing these districts.
Districts.label: Districts

DiveCameraTimeMax.description: Time after which to use DiveZOffsetMax

DiveCameraTimeMin.description: Time before which to use DiveZOffsetMin

DiveDelay.description: Dive duration before starting to give awards

DiveDodgeRollDistance.description: The distance the player moves when doing a dodge roll while diving (which is disabled by default).

DiveFOVBoost.description: How much to boost the FOV over the baseline when diving

DiveFOVSpeed.description: How fast to change the FOV when diving

DiveImpactTime.description: Amount of time to be diving where you will hard-impact

DivePitchDamp.description: Damp when blending towards dive pitch-target

DivePitchGain.description: Gain when blending towards dive pitch-target

DivePitchSpeed.description: How fast to change the pitch when diving

DivePitchTargetMax.description: Target pitch is interpolated between DivePitchTargetMin/Max based on time min/max

DivePitchTargetMin.description: Target pitch is interpolated between DivePitchTargetMin/Max based on time min/max

DivePitchTargetTimeDelay.description: How long after a dive begins to start pitching camera down

DivePitchTargetTimeMax.description: Target pitch is interpolated between DivePitchTargetMin/Max based on time min/max

DivePitchTargetTimeMin.description: Target pitch is interpolated between DivePitchTargetMin/Max based on time min/max

DiveTimeMax.description: Dive duration to apply full benefit

DiveTimeMid.description: Dive duration at which to provide DiveTimeMidValue as percent of max benefit

DiveTimeMin.description: Dive duration below which to provide no benefit

DiveYOffsetInSpeed.description: Blend speed of y-offset when diving

DiveYOffsetOutSpeed.description: Blend speed of y-offset when not-diving

Do180Turn.description: Should the bot turn 180 before grappling if the destination perch is behind it? Enable this option if the bot doesn't have SE/SW intro clips for it's grapple.
Do180Turn.label: Do 180 Turn?

DoCameraDirOverride.description: If TRUE, override the camera direction.

DoCarryIK.description: If TRUE, hero's left hand will IK to this actor's "CarryIKLocator" (specified below when this box is checked).

DoCeilingTouch.description: TRUE : Apply ceiling touch vars during jump. FALSE : Don't apply ceiling touch vars during jump.

DoClothColliderLookToggle.description: If TRUE, hero's cloth collider look will be toggled on to help keep capes from clipping through the carried person.

DoCollision.description: Do collision checks instead of using the move report results

DoCrimeReacts.description: After finishing the panic sequence, go into some crime reacts at the end, staring at the hero to watch the action

DoCylinderGravity.description: If true, do special cylinder gravity.

DoDamage.description: Overrides default behavior and specifies the complete set of actions in which the hero should still take damage

DoDamageWhileAttached.description: If TRUE we'll continue to try and break breakables and such while attached to our target

DoEngagedOverrideAnimOnce.description: If we have a OnEngagedOverrideAnim, setting this to true will make sure it only happens once

DoGroundExit.description: If true, hero will look to dismount to the ground rather than jump-exit

DoHeadshotReacts.description: True: Headshots cause CustomDamageSpecialReact with type SpecialReactNames::WebHeadshot

DoHitReact.description: Overrides default behavior and specifies the complete set of actions in which the hero should hit react

DoKnockback.description: Does it get knocked back when hit?

DoNotConnectNodes.description: A node this node should explicilty not connect with (only needs to be one way)

DoNotRestart.description: Do not restart after interruption from this point on

DoNotStartWithinDist.label: Do Not Start Within Dist

DoOpenCurveStop.description: Whether to slow to a stop at the end of an open path.

DoPhysicalMoveOnSwap.description: Whether we do a physical move of the heroes on swap.

DoPitchUpBiasing.description: If TRUE, we bias against targets below the plane (relative to hero position) as the camera pitches up

DoShapeCast.description: If this is off, we hit like a normal DodgeableHomingShotMotion. If it's on we'll use the shot model's collision data to do a shape cast against the target and consider outselves collided if we hit. Note the model collision geo should be VERY simple (as in you could count every poly youself in a few seconds) to avoid making this needlessly expensive. This is for big geo where normal collision queries aren't enough

DoSyncedReactFirst.description: If induced by a synced attack, whether to sync animations with the attacker before doing the specialized reaction

DoThrowLoot.description: If set loot will be thrown from the spawn position.

DoTunnel.description: If true, will tunnel through reference actor rather than standard jump

DoWAMNonTargetCollisionRequests.description: Turn this on if you want to do WAM collision tests even when there is no target of the attack.

DoWindDragOverride.description: TRUE : Use the drag value specified below for the wind drag value that affects cloth. FALSE : Use the default drag value defined in code.

DodgeBounds.description: Distance limits along hero's local XYZ direction for Dodge

DodgeCancelXZDistance.description: If the player gets this distance in XZ away from where the faller is going to land, cancel the dodge attack registration. -1.0 means no cancel.

DodgeCountBeforeCamo.description: How many dodges before miles activates camo
DodgeCountBeforeCamo.label: Dodge Count Before Camo

DodgeCounterFromAirStrafe.description: Dodge that happens when the player does a perfectly timed dodge in the air against a long range target, and the attack is marked as counterable

DodgeDirection.label: Dodge Direction

DodgeIntoWallGraspMaxAngle.description: Maximum angle between dodge direction and wall that allows us to stick when we hit it

DodgeJumpFailedAnim.description: Anim used when the player hits the jump button and they can't jump for some reason.

DodgeLockTimeMin.description: Time after a dodge to lock out steering entirely

DodgeOffEase.description: Ease in-out power on max-off ramp

DodgeSpecialReact.description: What a bot should trigger in order to try and block/dodge grenade.

DodgeTime.label: Dodge Time / Block Time

DodgeTimeMax.description: Ramp from DodgeZero to DodgeMax between DodgeTimeZero and DodgeTimeMax

DodgeTimeMin.description: Time after dodge to start ramping back to regular slip

DodgeTimeOff.description: Time after dodge to return to normal friction

DodgeTimeZero.description: Ramp from DodgeZero to DodgeMax between DodgeTimeZero and DodgeTimeMax

DomeActor.label: Dome Actor

DomeHealthCoeff.label: Dome Health Multiplier of User

Rendering > VisualEffects > Display Tagged Spawn Styles = ON

EnabledValidity.description: How enabled does the ProgressiveDamagePhases component have to be for this response to apply? These should be set so a Partially Enabled bot can be spawned at the start of a reloaded checkpoint and get "pre-damaged" in script and still have e.g. all the appropriate Looks toggled off for having taken that much damage, but not have anything happen that only makes sense in active gameplay. I.e. as we fade in from black you shouldn't be able to hear a bunch of destruction SFX play and see a bunch of dissipating smoke/embers/dust surrounding the bot, or a pile of freshly chunked looks at the bot's feet. We need to be able to instantly pop them to the right persistent state with things like looks toggling off and persistent FX getting turned on (e.g. a constant electric arc between two exposed wires on a broken armor piece). The ProgressiveDamagePhasesRequestEnabledEvent is what's used to control the bot's enabled state

IfNotModified.description: Only revert files that have not been modified.

IgnoreChaseAssist.description: If set, Chase Assist will not be used to adjust tether speeds when active.

LightAttenuationRadius.description: Optimization: The radius of a theoretical bounding sphere after which the light cuts off. This is a quick cutoff but not a sharp one to prevent being confused with a bug. This further attenuates physically-correct intensity falloff. The intent is to allow tight bounds on lights that otherwise would cover a great area with minimal contribution. In general a light should be authored with this at zero (default value) or a very large number so it does not influence the physically-correct falloff, then radius should be walked back to the smallest value where no difference is practically noticed. See Cutoff Dist, which is a hard end-of-influence bound that by-design causes lighting to stop with no graceful falloff. If Attenuation Radius is larger than Cutoff Dist, this continuity will become evident.
LightAttenuationRadius.label: Light Attenuation Radius

LightBulbLength.description:
For Capsule Area Lights this is the length of the capsule along the light's X axis.
For Rectangle Area Lights this is the length of the rectangle light source along the light's X axis.
LightBulbLength.label: Light Bulb Length

LightBulbPushForward.description:
For Spot/Pyramid Area Lights
The bulb's shape is pushed forward along the light direction by this many meters. The purpose is to allow the light to be recessed into the ceiling/wall so that its cone is roughly the size of the bulb when it emerges. Then this push forward attribute allows the bulb to appear where it's meant to be, not at the recessed location.
LightBulbPushForward.label: Light Bulb Push Forward

LightBulbRadius.description:
For Sphere/Capsule Area Lights this is the radius of the light source.
For Rectangle Area Lights this is the radial extent (i.e. half width) of the light source along the light's Y axis.
LightBulbRadius.label: Light Bulb Radius

LightCutOnDistance.description: The distance along the light's forward axis at which its contribution abruptly begins. This can be useful for embedding a spotlight or pyramid light in a wall or a ceiling so that at the point it emerges its area of influence is wider than a single point, especially when using area lights.
LightCutOnDistance.label: Light CutOn Distance

LightGridIntensity.description: Scales the intensity of the light grid and env probe lighting. Does not require recapturing.

LightType.description:
Select the light model:
LightGridMod are modulates lights that apply only during lightgrid capture
Modulate: A non-realistic flat multiplier on luminance
Point (aka Omni) Performance Note This casts 6x the shadows of a spot light, and incurs 6x the draw-call and vertex-related costs, use with care.
Pyramid is a square-type (frustum) spotlight, useful for gobo projections
Shaft (aka Directional) Scale of light impacts quality of shadow resolution. Useful for emulating key lighting coming through windows.
Spot Note the shadow map must cover the entire base of the cone, so defining wide inner and outer cone values will reduce shadow quality because it is stretched over a larger area.

MatchesPass.label: Matches Pass

MatchingSR.description: If not None, will make sure that the hit done has a special react matching this field before adding health

Material.description: Volumetric Cloud Rendering Material. This requires a special purpose Cloud usage type materialgraph and material to have any effect.
Material.label: Material

MaterialAsset.description: The specific material asset of the ground object
MaterialAsset.label: Material Asset

MaterialAssetPath.description: The asset path of the eye material.

MaterialConstant.description: The name of the material constant that will be set for the material mapping associated with this body part.

MaterialConstants.description: Constants are set on both the drone and the dome actors.
MaterialConstants.label: Material Constants

MaterialCount.description: Indicates scene complexity and liklihood of context rolling.

MaterialLodDist.description: The distance that the material transitions from lod 0 to lod 1. If set to 0 (the default) it will fall back to the setting in the Material asset, and then to the Material Graph asset, and then finally the per-project MaterialLod Settings.
MaterialLodDist.label: Material Lod Dist

MaterialMappingName.description: The Maya material mapping to apply this setting to.
MaterialMappingName.label: MaterialMappingName

MaterialMappingsToSkip.description: Names of the material mappings to skip for when this actor is outlined by ActorOutlineManager

MaterialOverride.description: Optional. If set, this material will override the material mapping(s) for the part type
MaterialOverride.label: Material Override

MaterialOverrides.description: A list of material overrides to apply on this variant.
MaterialOverrides.label: Material Overrides

MaterialPost.description: Leads the disolve effect to give it a visible edge
MaterialPost.label: Material Post

MaterialProperties.description: This contains properties used for compositing the road material.
MaterialProperties.label: Material Properties

MaterialPropertiesOverrideValues.description: Use these numbers instead of default or Maya-configured materials

MaterialToSetTexture.description: The material to set (per item) on the model above.

MaterialVariantConfig.description: Applies a MaterialVariantsConfig to randomly swap out some materials
MaterialVariantConfig.label: Material Variants Config

Max.description: This field is only for use in the ui code to inform the color grade picker what the intensity minimum is.
Max.label: Maximum

MaxAccelDelay.description: Delay before changing max-speed to fit to max-min/max-max window

MaxAccelSpeed.description: Maximum rate of change of max speed

MaxAcceleration.description: How much acceleration can be applied to each axis
MaxAcceleration.label: Max Acceleration

MaxAccumAngle.description: If the total amount of angle change the shot undergoes during its lifetime exceeds this, homing will stop.

MaxAccumRange.description: Shot will stop bouncing if total travel distance exceeds this value

MaxActivations.description: Number of times the trap can be triggered. -1 for infinite.

MaxActiveActors.description: Maximum number of actors that can be active at one time (-1 = infinite)

MaxActiveDistance.description: Critter locations more than this distance away from the hero may not be active.
MaxActiveDistance.label: Max Active Distance

MaxActiveEvents.description: Hard cap on the number of events of this category that can exist at once. Negative value disables the Max Active limits.
MaxActiveEvents.label: Max Active Events

MaxActiveParticles.description: How many particles allowed to exist at a time. When number is reached, no more will spawn until some die.
MaxActiveParticles.label: Max Active Particles

MaxActiveVenomClouds.description: What is the maximum number of venom clouds that can be active at any given time? Spawning a new cloud will deactivate an existing cloud.

MaxAdditionalSpeed.description: How much additional speed a full meter can add to movement

MaxAdjustments.description: Maximum number of times to dynamically adjust difficulty based on deaths.

MaxAheadDistance.description: At our max speed, we project ahead this distance.
MaxAheadDistance.label: Max Ahead Distance

MaxAimAngle.description: The player cannot aim the lure higher than this angle above the XZ plane.

MaxAimPitchDown.description: If we're matching a dynamic aim angle on the hero, don't pitch the camera down beyond this many degrees. If the pitch ends up getting limited, any fov change will get automatically limited proportionally
MaxAimPitchDown.label: Max Aim Pitch Down

MaxAimPitchUp.description: If we're matching a dynamic aim angle on the hero, don't pitch the camera up beyond this many degrees. If the pitch ends up getting limited, any fov change will get automatically limited proportionally
MaxAimPitchUp.label: Max Aim Pitch Up

MaxAirSnapDistanceXZ.description: Max distance to travel for snapping to our target

MaxAirSnapDistanceY.description: Max distance to travel for snapping to our target

MaxAlive.description: Optional limit on the max number of this type to spawn. (0 means not used)

MaxAlliesToUse.description: If non-zero then there can be most this many attackers (including yourself) to use this combo.
MaxAlliesToUse.label: Max Allies To Use

MaxAllowedTargeters.description: Maximum targeters can the super ally can have
MaxAllowedTargeters.label: Max Allowed Targeters

MaxAngleAdjustment.description: For shot hitmarkers, if the ground is on a slope of this angle or less, the marker will be oriented to match

MaxAngleConfidenceBias.description: Bias to apply when angle is easiest to judge (pushing towards of the camera). Lower number favors distance.

MaxAngleDeviation.description: Max angle deviation from travel direction in degrees

MaxAngleDiffToStart.description: examines the rotation delta between the current game camera and the starting orientation that would happen if the camera got activated. If the angle is greater than this, the camera won't get activated. This is mostly legacy as we've found we generally always want an animated camera to play if present
MaxAngleDiffToStart.label: Max Angle Diff To Start

MaxAngleDistanceBiasXZ.description: How much farther per degree of angle offset this target is perceived

MaxAngleFirePitch.description: Maximum Pitch angle from camera that we will assist when firing
MaxAngleFirePitch.label: Max Fire Pitch Angle

MaxAngleFireYaw.description: Maximum Yaw angle from camera that we will assist when firing
MaxAngleFireYaw.label: Max Fire Yaw Angle

MaxAngleFromBase.description: Maximum angle measured from the direction we are yanking from

MaxAngleFromCameraOrientation.description: The max angle (in degrees) that goto positions will be generated in. the span of the wedge is -MaxAngle to MaxAngle. 0 is straight ahead from the player's perspective.

MaxAngleFromIdeal.description: The max angle that the dash can deviate from the original dash direction.

MaxAngleFromInput.description: Maximum angle measured from direction we are pushing on the stick

MaxAngleGrabPitch.description: Maximum Pitch angle from camera that you are allowed to TK grab objects
MaxAngleGrabPitch.label: Max Grab Pitch Angle

MaxAngleGrabYaw.description: Maximum Yaw angle from camera that you are allowed to TK grab objects
MaxAngleGrabYaw.label: Max Grab Yaw Angle

MaxAngleOffsetExtraSeconds.description: AngleOffsetPerExtraSeconds above will never add more than this many seconds to the projected time. -1 = no limit to extra time
MaxAngleOffsetExtraSeconds.label: Max Angle Offset Extra Seconds

MaxAngleToSpawn.description: Vignettes will only spawn within this angle of camera forward

MaxAnglesWithInput.description: Used to define the min/max angles we use for targeting as a function of the stick input direction (RelativeAngle). We will interpolate the defined regions based on actual stick input

MaxAngularMomentumAngle.description: Max angle we can adjust the ejection angle by due to the bot spinning around. Bots at a farther radius will use the max

MaxAnimClueDistance.description: Max distance for anim clues near where the lure lands.

MaxAnimIndex.description: The maximum anim filter Index available on the SpawnAnim. Entering 0 prevents any bot from geting an Index anim filter set
MaxAnimIndex.label: Max Anim Index

MaxAnimRate.description: Maximum rate that the fly anim will play.
MaxAnimRate.label: Max Loop Anim Rate

MaxAnimRateScaleByDistance.description: Maximum effect dodging longer distances can have on anim rate

MaxAnimSetCount.description: Maximum number of anim sets in the stack

MaxAnimStartOffset.description: To prevent twinning with AOE status, allow the electrified driver to randomly start, at most, this far into the driver. 0.5 = allow the first half of the anim to be skipped over
MaxAnimStartOffset.label: Max Anim Start Offset

MaxAnimTreeSize.description: Maximum size for the cached anim tree

MaxAnimVarCount.description: Maximum number of valid anim vars this instance can track

MaxApplications.description: Don't apply the Effect to more than this many bots, even if more are in the AOE. 0 = as many as possible
MaxApplications.label: Max Applications

MaxArcDist.description: How many meters around the hero to search for new targets

MaxArcHeight.description: Maximum height of our fake arc when traveling to the target

MaxArcs.description: Send out no more than this many arcs. The arcs will always go to the closest valid targets

MaxAscentHeight.description: How high to ascent at maximum range

MaxAttachDistance.description: The maximum distance any collision check is allowed to go

MaxAttachedBots.description: How many bots can we grab. This can get overridden by progression

MaxAttackDist.description: Maximum distance at which Venom will attack the player.

MaxAttacksPerUse.description: The number of attacks to affect after entering camo.

MaxAttenuation.description: Max distance this sound can be heard at specified in source tool

MaxAwayFromTargetAngle.description: When initially traveling at MaxSpeed, how many degrees offset from the target should we start the shot at. This gives time for the AngularVelocity to curve it back in

MaxBackwardsTrackingDistance.description: If value is >= 0, determines the maximum distance hero is allowed to move backwards in order to achieve ideal distance to target.

MaxBeepInterval.description: The maximum amount of time between hot-cold beeps. 0 disables hot-cold.

MaxBend.description: Maximum bend distance of line. If line attempts to bend beyond this, elasticity is reduced to compensate.

MaxBiasAngle.description: Clamp the actual angle value to this for generating our angle bias. A smaller value limits how much we can bias against a target for being inaccurate with the stick direction (and thus makes distance more important... this is also counter-intuitive, but if everything had the same angle rating then the only differentating factor would be distance)

MaxBiasPercent.description: The maximum percent we can bias from the Ideal to the MinSettle

MaxBirdSpacing.description: There may be at most this much space between birds on a ledge path.
MaxBirdSpacing.label: Max Bird Spacing

MaxBirdsPerLedge.description: Don't spawn more than this many birds on each ledge, even if the ledge can support more.
MaxBirdsPerLedge.label: Max Birds Per Ledge

MaxBloodTrailLength.description: Once a blood trail is created, it will have max distance of this. If we make trail longer than this, we will start deleting first-most drops of trail to maintain max length

MaxBonusDistance.description: Maximum amount of bonus distance we apply to Far Distance. Use -1 for default behavior

MaxBotAttachTime.description: How long should the bots stay attached to the hero before getting ejected. Use -1 to eject at the end of the move

MaxBotAttachedHeightOffset.description: Maximum height offset for attached secondary bots relative to the attachment line

MaxBounceHeight.description: The maximum height we can ever bounce up to

MaxBounces.description: Determines the maximum number of bounces the simulated light should have.

MaxButtonMashInterval.description: How long we should wait for button mash input until we retreat from pulling the shot

MaxButtonTapHoldTime.description: A held button longer than this interval will be discounted as a button-tap

MaxCabinLightDistance.description: Interior cabin lights will only be turned on while within this distance of the hero. Event name: TrainCarCabinLightsEvent
MaxCabinLightDistance.label: Max Cabin Light Distance

MaxCamDist.description: Maximum distance the camera cam get. Use -1 to automatically make the Default Distance the max.

MaxCamHalfDegrees.description: If the target is within this many degrees from the camera's forward then this check will pass.

MaxCameraDistanceFromVent.description: Maximum distance the camera can be from the vent in the XZ direction.

MaxCameraFollowAngle.description: Max amount in degrees camera will turn away from wall normal automatically when moving

MaxCameraPitchOnMoveStick.description: Maximum amount of pitch to apply to the movement stick when the camera is pitched

MaxCenterOffsetDistance.description: Optional limit to how far the camera pivot can get pulled away from the hero. This is max distance in meters. Use -1 to ignore

MaxChaseSpeed.description: Maximum speed this actor is allowed to go.
MaxChaseSpeed.label: Max Chase Speed

MaxChunkHealth.description: The max health of the destructible
MaxChunkHealth.label: Health

MaxCloseDistanceInvestigators.description: Number of investigators that will get within the CloseInvestigateDistance.

MaxCloseDistanceToEnd.description: Max distance in front of the camera to end close mode. Should be larger than the start distance to provide a buffer

MaxCloseDistanceToStart.description: Max distance in front of the camera to start close mode

MaxCloseEnemies.description: If there are more than this enemies in our 'close' region the condition is invalid. Use -1 to not use a maximum

MaxCloseHeightDown.description: Max height offset down for enemy to be considered close

MaxCloseHeightUp.description: Max height offset up for enemy to be considered close

MaxConsecutiveFailures.description: Prevents the proc from failing to trigger more than X times in a row, at the expense of true randomness.

MaxConsecutiveProcs.description: Prevents the proc from triggering more than X times in a row, at the expense of true randomness.

MaxContactImpulseAtHighSpeed.description: Limit total force that will be applied to a kickable by an animated character traveling at or above the 'high speed threshold'. I think this is probably newtons?
MaxContactImpulseAtHighSpeed.label: Contact Impulse clipping at high speed

MaxContactImpulseAtLowSpeed.description: Limit total force that will be applied to a kickable by an animated character traveling at or below the 'low speed threshold'. I think this is probably newtons?
MaxContactImpulseAtLowSpeed.label: Contact Impulse clipping at low speed

MaxConversationStartDist.description: Max distance to start conversations or cell phone monologues

MaxCooldown.description: Max time before Miles can use his invisibility again

MaxCooldownDistance.description: Distance cooldown mult will be at MaxCooldownDistanceMult at this distance or more from last spawn

MaxCooldownRefund.description: If an allowed number of enemies are hit with the jump, clear this percentage of the cooldown
MaxCooldownRefund.label: Max Cooldown Refund

MaxCount.description: Maximum pois used for this setting. Negative means unlimited. Reaching the max will try to assign the poi to a different squadmate param entry.
MaxCount.label: Max Count

MaxCounterDodgeOverInputAngle.description: Max stick angle from the target for which we'll dodge accurately over a target

MaxCulledUpdateDistance.description: Maximum distance to which animation is updated when the actor was not drawn the previous frame. (0.0 always tries to update).

MaxDamageDistance.description: Only deal damage while the hero is within this distance of this train car.
MaxDamageDistance.label: Max Damage Distance

MaxDamageFromBombs.description: The amount of damage the player needs to take from Symbiote Bombs before this reminder is displayed.

MaxDamageImmunityTime.description: If this is non-negative, this sets a maximum amount of time we'll be given damage immunity in the event of a dodge (both perfect and non-perfect)
MaxDamageImmunityTime.label: Max Damage Immunity Time

MaxDamageMultColor.description: Color of the indicator when our damage multiplier is maximized. Lerps from the min color and our multiplier increases.
MaxDamageMultColor.label: Max Damage Mult Color

MaxDeactivateScalingDistance.description: AutoDeactivateTime cooldown mult will be at MaxDeactivateScalingMult at this distance or more from crime

MaxDegreeRotationPerSecond.description: This is the number of degrees the VTOL is allowed to rotate per second.

MaxDelayBetweenSpawns.description: Used to control the maximum time between spawns

MaxDelayTime.description: Max amount of time this react can delay before happening.

MaxDeltaDown.description: Maximum distance volume can be moved down from initial position

MaxDeltaUp.description: Maximum distance volume can be moved up from initial position

MaxDeployed.description: Max number of Electric Web gadgets that can be deployed at once.

MaxDescentHeight.description: Descent will do straight line path to the target. Using a descent height can curve this very slightly

MaxDiffractionBlendDistanceScalar.description: Multiplied with Insideness to determine the max distance where diffraction can start occurring, and minimum diffraction values are applied.

MaxDisplacement.description: Maximum displacement when maximum force is reached.
MaxDisplacement.label: Max Displacement

MaxDisplacementPercent.description: The maximum amount the rope can be displaced as a function of the rope length

MaxDissolveDelay.description: Max Delay to start disolving the body based on the DissolveType

MaxDissolveDuration.description: Max duration for the dissolve to happen

MaxDist.description: Only accept jobs from bots within this distance
MaxDist.label: Maximum Distance

MaxDistAngleTol.description: At far distance, if the target aim angle is larger than this, we will give up snapping
MaxDistAngleTol.label: Max Distance Angle Tolerance

MaxDistFromHero.description: The max distance the bot is allowed to go to from the hero.

MaxDistFromHeroY.description: The max Y distance from the hero where we will generate goto positions.

MaxDistFromIdealInitial.description: Maximum distance a collision result is allowed to be from the initial ideal joint position

MaxDistFromIdealStretch.description: Maximum distance a a joint is allowed to move from the ideal joint position

MaxDistFromTarget.description: How far the bot can be from their target before they jump off of their perch.

MaxDistPreviousScoring.description: The larger value past which points will be weighted the least

MaxDistXZ_InnerYaw.description: Maximum XZ distance of the target when in our Inner Yaw region

MaxDistXZ_OuterYaw.description: Maximum XZ distance of the target when in our Outer Yaw region

MaxDistY_InnerYaw.description: Maximum Y distance of the target when in our Inner Yaw region. NOTE: This is NOT exclusive. If the target is within Y tolerance OR Pitch tolerance they will be framed

MaxDistY_OuterYaw.description: Maximum Y distance of the target when in our Outer Yaw region. NOTE: This is NOT exclusive. If the target is within Y tolerance OR Pitch tolerance they will be framed

MaxDistance.description: The maximum distance that the wind simulation vector field will extend out to over the XZ plane.
MaxDistance.label: Max Distance

MaxDistanceBetweenShieldAndTarget.description: Beyond this distance we'll ramp up the urgency we need to get in range, provided we haven't already hit the target. Only used prior to damaging the target.

MaxDistanceForLongRangeTransition.description: Camera distance from the bot at this many meters and further will be fully using long range material on entire bot's model. Blends when between min/max

MaxDistanceForPrimaryDamage.description: If we don't reach this close to our Primary Parry target within our damage delivery window, then we won't do parry damage to the target

MaxDistanceFromPrimaryTargetXZ.description: Max horizontal distance between the two targets

MaxDistanceFromPrimaryTargetY.description: Max height distance between the two targets

MaxDistanceFromResetDuringAOE.label: Max Distance From Reset During AOE

MaxDistanceToSkipDepthTest.description: We want the circulatory system to render through everything, but this is the maximum distance the camera can be from the bot for it to render over everything. -1 means there is no maximum.

MaxDistractionAngle.description: The ally does not turn to face the distraction object, so they won't throw to things more than this many degrees off their facing direction

MaxDodgeEndDamageImmunityTime.description: When the dodging action ends and the damage immunity is still active, this is the max duration we will let it persist

MaxDrawDistance.description: Particles fade away when they are further away from the camera than this distance.

MaxDropDist.description: When sliding on the ground, we try to not drop off ledges. This value can be used to control the max ledge height we can drop off. Use -1 to use internal default value used in all combat states. Use a number > 0 to override

MaxDropHeight.description: Maximum height the ledge we vault over can be

MaxDropRate.description: Max possible drop rate the system can reach

MaxDuration.description: Maximum play duration for this sound event (in seconds).

MaxDynamicForce.description: Maximum force exerted on the model instance before it stops reacting further.
MaxDynamicForce.label: Max Dynamic Force

MaxDynamicLinkedActors.description: Max number of actors that can be linked via the Destructible Link Actors script node, this is independent to predefined linked actor count
MaxDynamicLinkedActors.label: Max Dynamic Linked Actors

MaxDynamicPitchScreenPct.description: The maximum amount the pivot can drift from the center of the screen in order to better frame targets. Number is a percentage of the half vertical FOV

MaxEjectConeAngle.description: Force the impact direction into a cone of this size

MaxEnemyCount.description: Number of known enemies must not exceed this AND within the shape
MaxEnemyCount.label: Max Enemy Count

MaxEnemyDist.description: At this distance we use SetMaxCamDist
MaxEnemyDist.label: Max Enem yDist

MaxEnemyHits.description: Shot will stop bouncing once it has hit this many enemies

MaxEnemyInShapeCount.description: Max number of enemies that must be in the shape
MaxEnemyInShapeCount.label: Max Enemy In Shape Count

MaxEnemyRadius.description: Heavy enemy must be within this range for this entry to activate.

MaxEnergy.description: Only show this message when the hero has at most this much focus.
MaxEnergy.label: Maximum Energy

MaxExitAngle.description: Maximum allowed exit angle variance from entry angle driven by input

MaxExitUpwardsEnd.description: Apply the full MaxExitVelocityUpwards when the hero's height when exiting is this many meters above the shooter's position from the start of the dodge. Between Start and End we blend from the unclamped velocity and the Max Upwards limit
MaxExitUpwardsEnd.label: Max Exit Upwards Height End

MaxExitUpwardsStart.description: Only start factoring in MaxExitVelocityUpwards when the hero's height when exiting is this many meters above the shooter's position from the start of the dodge. The purpose of MaxExitVelocity is so the player isn't launched unreasonably high up above the arena, but we don't necessarily care if they get a nice boost up from the very bottom of the arena into a higher playable area
MaxExitUpwardsStart.label: Max Exit Upwards Height Start

MaxExitVelocity.description: If the hero transitions from this dodge into a fall state they'll try to inherit the dodge's final velocity. That can be REALLY BIG, so this lets you clamp how much the next state will inherit from what the dodge added. Regardless of this value try to preserve as much of the hero's pre-dodge velocity as possible. -1 = don't clamp at all
MaxExitVelocity.label: Max Exit Velocity

MaxExitVelocityUpwards.description: Constrain just the upwards component of the hero's velocity on top of MaxExitVelocity. Unlike MaxExitVelocity, this upwards constrain does also apply to the hero's pre-dodge velocity, so it makes sense for it to be bigger than MaxExitVelocity
MaxExitVelocityUpwards.label: Max Exit Velocity Upwards

MaxExtents.description: Vector that defines the maximum distance, POSITIVELY, along each axis we can translate from the actors original location
MaxExtents.label: Max Extents

MaxFaceWebDist.description: If the web impact location is farther than this from the FaceWebTargetLocIndex (e.g. because he brought his arm up in front of his face and that blocked the web) ignore the damage instead of applying that status
MaxFaceWebDist.label: Max Face Web Distance

MaxFacingAngle.description: This is the maximum angle that the player can face away from this interact and it still be available.
MaxFacingAngle.label: Max Facing Angle

MaxFacingAngleThreshold.description: The maximum angle the hero can be facing away from the damage source in order to perform the knockback
MaxFacingAngleThreshold.label: Max Facing Threshold

MaxFallDeltaMax.description: Maximum fall distance when in-speed is InSpeedMax

MaxFallDeltaMin.description: Maximum fall distance when in-speed is InSpeedMin

MaxFallGravity.description: Limits the gravity computed for falling. Use positive values. Negative values mean we don't apply it.

MaxFallSpeed.description: Speed limit for falling from this move

MaxFallTime.description: Maximum time you can fall in the ground pound if done from air

MaxFireDistance.description: Maximum distance we're allowed to fire at a target/aim mode. We'll hit a point at this distance away if the target is further

MaxFireWait.description: The maximum time to wait between fires.
MaxFireWait.label: Max wait between fires

MaxFiringDistance.description: Define a distance which we consider long range
MaxFiringDistance.label: Far Range Distance

MaxFlatPathLength.description: Maximum length of the path where we jump between navigation that wouldn't require a clue
MaxFlatPathLength.label: Max Flat Path Length

MaxFlutterRate.description: The flutter rate (i.e. anim rate) of a bird that has reached the landing position.

MaxFollowTime.description: Maximum flight-time history of the actor to track

MaxForce.description: The maximum amount of drag we're able to apply. Bigger numbers apply more drag. It's used as the drag coefficient in the drag equation, so you can roughly think of it as defining how "streamlined" the hero is. For context 0.59 is an average value for normal air, but you probably want something bigger and very not normal
MaxForce.label: Max Force

MaxForceCleanupDistance.description: When the event is completely infront of us, if it is beyond this distance, force cleanup
MaxForceCleanupDistance.label: Max Force Cleanup Distance

MaxForceRadius.description: The force varies based on how close the hero is to this volume's up axis. MaxForce is used when the hero is within this distance from the avoidance radius, and the force ramps down to 0 as the hero approaches the opposite end of the volume
MaxForceRadius.label: Max Force Radius

MaxForwardDeviation.description: Clamp the stick input on the dodge so that it's no more than this many degrees off from this volume's forward direction
MaxForwardDeviation.label: Max Forward Deviation

MaxForwardDistance.description: Crimes can spawn up to this distance away if within ForwardSpawnAngle of camera forward

MaxFuturePathRefillDistance.description: When filling the track queue, stop picking tracks once the future path length is the train's stopping distance plus this distance. Must be larger than the min refill distance.

MaxGenericChunks.description: Max Num Generic chunks to come off
MaxGenericChunks.label: Max Generic Chunks

MaxGotoDuration.description: Abort if this move has been in the goto state for this long without starting. -1 means never abort
MaxGotoDuration.label: Max Goto Duration

MaxGrabAccel.description: How fast the obejct is allowed to accelerates when you grab it
MaxGrabAccel.label: Max Grab Acceleration

MaxGrabSpeed.description: The maximum speed the object can reach when you grab it
MaxGrabSpeed.label: Max Grab Speed

MaxGraceDuration.description: A normal grace period will last this many seconds
MaxGraceDuration.label: Max Grace Duration

MaxGreenNodeWiggleDist.description: The maximum distance from it's normal position a green node can travel when wiggling.

MaxGroundDistance.description: We'll always switch to the airborne driver on a foot, when the bot itself is grounded but the distance between the foot locators exceeds this distance
MaxGroundDistance.label: Max Ground Distance

MaxGroundInfluenceScreenPct.description: How much the pivot is allowed to get pulled towards the ground as a percentage of screen size. Number is a percentage of the half vertical FOV

MaxHPPercentage.description: Percentage of default max HP that the target will have during this stage.

MaxHealthOverride.description: Max health for elite variants. <= 0 to not override.

MaxHeavyWeightSlots.description: The maximum number of Heavy Weoght types allowed to have instances loaded at once.

MaxHeight.description: The max height the fireworks can go before exploding.
MaxHeight.label: Max Firework Height

MaxHeightBoostedPromoteDist.description: Scaled by the Min and MaxOnscreenRangeBoostHeight and appended to MaxPromoteDist. The higher up we are, the further out onscreen promotion can be.

MaxHeightGain.description: Maximum jump height above either the start or end location that we will allow the bot to go. Used for areas we are concerned about ceiling clearance. May lower DistToHeight and squash the arc. -1 is unlimited.

MaxHeightRange.description: How far up the player can target the lure when in aim mode.

MaxHeroSpeed.description: Scales the ideal ledge flock spawn distance by hero speed - the ideal spawn distance will be the min spawn distance when the hero is not moving, and the ideal spawn distance will be the max spawn distance when the hero is moving at or faster than this speed.
MaxHeroSpeed.label: Max Hero Speed

MaxHeroToWallCollisionAngle.description: Max angle we search for collision from hero to target to wall normal to initiate a wall/railing attack

MaxHighMipsWaitTime.description: Wait at most this amount of time after starting the cinematic for high mips to stream in.

MaxHits.description: Optional maximum number of hits against our target that will let us end the attack early.

MaxHorizontalRandomMultiplier.description: Maximum random variation applied to distance

MaxHotColdPingDistance.description: Maximum distance from the camera that the actor can be at to send audio hot/cold ping events. (no further than this distance)
MaxHotColdPingDistance.label: Max Hot/Cold Ping Distance

MaxHoverHeightAboveGround.description: The maximum height we're willing to hover above the ground.

MaxHoverTime.description: Stop hovering if passing the max time, negative means infinite hover time
MaxHoverTime.label: Hover Max Time

MaxIdealDistFromHero.description: The max distance the bot should ideally stay from the hero.

MaxIdealPathLength.description: The ideal maximum length a path can be to a new position. This will help the bot favor mid-range repositions and prevent running around stuff to get to a close-up position. Note: This isn't the distance from point A->B. It's the length of the path she'll take to get there.

MaxIdealSlideSpeed.description: Limit on how fast we are able to slide into place if we are too far away.

MaxIdleSpeed.description: The hero is considered idle if he is moving slower than this speed.
MaxIdleSpeed.label: Max Idle Speed

MaxIdleTime.description: Maximum amount of time bot will not look at anything in the environment
MaxIdleTime.label: Max Idle Time

MaxIgnore.description: How many incoming damage packets to ignore. If <0, ignores infinite.

MaxIncomingAngle.description: The maximum skimming angle (degrees) the player can hit the wall at and still get deflected. If the angle is more than this (i.e. more head on), the hero will pass through the plane without effect. Deflection happens on the single closest deflecting face plane the hero's motion would take them through
MaxIncomingAngle.label: Max Incoming Angle

MaxInheritedVelocity.description: Normally we try to make the hero and shot cross past each other at whatever time they would have met with their pre-dodge velocity. However if the hero is moving extremely quickly towards or away from the shot, that can lead to dodges that are too fast or slow. So if this is >0, we don't factor in any hero speed past it
MaxInheritedVelocity.label: Max Inherited Velocity

MaxInitialSpeed.description: Initial speed at maximum range. WARNING: using this with MinPeakSpeed can cause MinTime/MaxTime to be violated

MaxInitialSpeedWithNoTarget.description: Optional clamp on initial speed when we don't have a target'

MaxInputHalfYaw.description: Half angle of how much yaw they can adjust the input by.

MaxIntensityThreshold.description: Threshold of transitioning between high and max intensity
MaxIntensityThreshold.label: Max Intensity Threshold

MaxInteractDistance.description: Max distance from AttachLocator where the Spider Bot can be.

MaxInteractPitch.description: Max vertical angle from the forward of the AttachLocator where the Spider Bot can be.

MaxInteractYaw.description: Max horizontal angle from the forward of the AttachLocator where the Spider Bot can be.

MaxInterval.description: Maximum line distance between two consecutive knots

MaxIntroAnimRate.description: Used to limit how fast the Intro can scale. By default we try and rate scale the Intro so it will finish at the time the attack lands. If we limit the Intro rate, then we will interrupt the Intro when the attack lands.

MaxIronRushDistancePostImpactPct.description: Invalid = -1.0, Valid Range 0-1. If >= 0 Iron Rush distance will be limited to a maximum of default IronRushDistance multiplied by this value AFTER this actor is impacted For example, if this value is 0.5 and default IronRushDistance is 16, resulting post-impact distance limit will be 8

MaxJitterX.description: Max amount we jitter the position of the bot sideways when attached

MaxJitterY.description: Max amount we jitter the position fo the bot up/down when attached

MaxJumpDownDistanceXZ.description: The maximum horizontal distance the critter may cover when jumping down.
MaxJumpDownDistanceXZ.label: Max Jump Down Distance XZ

MaxJumpDownPauseTime.description: The maximum amount of time the critter idles after turning around, but before jumping down.
MaxJumpDownPauseTime.label: Jump Down Max Pause Time

MaxKnockbackDistanceOverride.description: An override for the maximum distance the hero will travel when knocked back. Negative values mean not set.
MaxKnockbackDistanceOverride.label: Max Knockback Distance Override

MaxKnockbackLevelAllowed.description: Never allow a knockback level higher than this!
MaxKnockbackLevelAllowed.label: Max Knockback Level Allowed

MaxLAPStareTime.description: Maximum amount of time bot will look at anything in the environment
MaxLAPStareTime.label: Max POI Stare Time

MaxLandGroundAdjustDown.description: How much are we able to adjust the landing position down to account for ground

MaxLandGroundAdjustUp.description: How much are we able to adjust the landing position up to account for ground

MaxLandHeightDiff.description: Birds may not land at locations more than this distance from the hero vertically.
MaxLandHeightDiff.label: Max Land Height Diff

MaxLandHeightOffset.description: How far above the target can we land

MaxLandNormalAngle.description: Birds may not land on locations that have a surface normal that is more than this angle (degrees) from the +Y axis.
MaxLandNormalAngle.label: Max Land Normal Angle

MaxLean.description: Max value on the Lean anim var

MaxLengthMoving.description: Max length of this tentacle while the hero is moving.
MaxLengthMoving.label: Max Tentacle Length (Moving)

MaxLengthStationary.description: Max length of this tentacle while the hero is stationary.
MaxLengthStationary.label: Max Tentacle Length (Stationary)

MaxLevel.description: Higher knockbacks will be clamped down to this level
MaxLevel.label: Max Level

MaxLifetime.description: The longest length of time any component arc will stay visible for
MaxLifetime.label: Max Lifetime

MaxLightDistance.description: Signal lights will only be turned on while within this distance of the hero.
MaxLightDistance.label: Max Light Distance

MaxLineCheckLength.description: Maximum distance our line check is allowed to extend looking for collision

MaxLines.description: Maximum number of weblines the player can have out at once.

MaxLinkInfluenceHitAngle.description: Prevents the hit direction angle relative to the primary fire direction from ever exceeding this amount

MaxLookChunks.description: Max Num Attached chunks to come off
MaxLookChunks.label: Max Look Chunks

MaxLookSwaps.description: Max Num Look Swaps to perform
MaxLookSwaps.label: Max Look Swap

MaxMinimumPlaytime.description: The amount of time the max intensity state will play for without transitioning down.
MaxMinimumPlaytime.label: Max Minimum Playtime

MaxMomentum.description: Max value on the Momentum anim var

MaxMomentumBaseFinal.description: Momentum value used as reference against adjusted base for scaling boosts

MaxMomentumBaseStart.description: Momentum value that is considered the standard action cap

MaxMomentumDive.description: Max fall momentum value when manual diving

MaxMomentumFall.description: Max fall momentum value when not diving

MaxMomentumFullFinal.description: Momentum value used as reference against adjusted base for scaling boosts

MaxMomentumFullStart.description: Momentum value that the true cap for all moves

MaxMoveCount.description: Optionally only apply this entry when the global move count is at least this value
MaxMoveCount.label: Max Move Count To Be Valid

MaxMoveDistance.description: Maximum distance we will move to try to position
MaxMoveDistance.label: Max Move Distance

MaxMultIncrease.description: What the max damage multiplier we will allow
MaxMultIncrease.label: Max Mult Increase

MaxNeighborDistance.description: When calculating a flock member's cohesion/alignment forces, neighbors are within this distance.
MaxNeighborDistance.label: Max Neighbor Distance

MaxNoLOSTime.description: How long the bot can stay on their perch after losing LOS of their target.

MaxNonStreamedSize.description: The max allowed size (in bytes) for non-streamed cinematics. Exceeding this size results in a builder error. Value of 0 means no limit.

MaxNonSweetSpotIntensity.description: Max intensity for this channel of haptics when this side is not in the sweet spot.
MaxNonSweetSpotIntensity.label: Haptic Max Non Sweet Spot Intensity

MaxNorthSouthAngle.description: The maximum angle away from true north-south a road can be to be considered.

MaxNumDestructiblesPerFrame.description: This is the max number of destructibles that this shot can destroy in one frame. -1 places no limit on the max number of destructibles.

MaxNumDodgers.description: This is the max number of bots that are allowed to dodge this explosion. Defaults to 128

MaxNumIntermediateRoomsPerEmitter.description: Limits number of intermediate rooms per emitter - affects performance.

MaxNumSpawns.description: Set max the number of loot to spawn from this config, set to -1 for no max
MaxNumSpawns.label: Loot to Spawn

MaxOffScreenAttackers.description: Maximum number of ranged guys firing simultaneously if everyone is offscreen.
MaxOffScreenAttackers.label: Max Off Screen Attackers

MaxOffscreenDistance.description: Crimes can spawn up to this distance away if bewteen ForwardSpawnAngle and OffscreenSpawnAngle of camera forward

MaxOffscreenSpawnAngle.description: Crimes bewteen ForwardSpawnAngle and this angle from camera forward can spawn up to MaxOffscreenDistance, crimes greater than this angle from camera forward cannot spawn

MaxOffscreenTime.description: How long the bot can stay on their perch after it goes off-screen.

MaxOnScreenAttackers.description: Maximum number of ranged guys firing simultaneously if anyone is onscreen.
MaxOnScreenAttackers.label: Max On Screen Attackers

MaxOnscreenRangeBoostHeight.description: Camera Y Height is compared against these min/max values to lerp the MaxHeightBoostedPromoteDist, which is appended to MaxPromoteDist

MaxParkedCars.description: The maximum number of parked cars we would ever want to spawn.

MaxParticles.description: How many particles allowed to spawn in total. Overrides other parameters like emitter lifetime, spawn rate, etc.
MaxParticles.label: Max Spawned Particles

MaxPassRadius.description: Normally we let the hero and shot converge at their pre-dodge speed, but if they were both moving relatively slowly, this can take too long and leave the hero in a big slowmo anim. Don't let the dodge position extend out farther than this many meters from the shot. So if necessary the hero will add velocity towards the shot when they dodge
MaxPassRadius.label: Max Pass Radius

MaxPathDistFromHero.description: Audio source actor will be positioned this distance along the path to the target or less.
MaxPathDistFromHero.label: Max Path Distance From Hero

MaxPathLength.description: Maximum length of the path where we will attempt to jump shortcut it
MaxPathLength.label: Max Path Length

MaxPeakPercent.description: How far along our travel distance should our peak occur at when at maximum range

MaxPerFrameGameInteractions.description: Maximum number of gameplay interactions/hits per frame
MaxPerFrameGameInteractions.label: Max Interactions Per Frame

MaxPercentAlive.description: Comms check will be triggered once the remaining enemies drops to this percentage or fewer. Set to <=0 if you only want the comms check to trigger when Last Stand is triggered.
MaxPercentAlive.label: Max Percent Alive

MaxPercentOutOfView.description: Percent of our MaxAlive that out of the view frustum of the camera

MaxPerfectDodgeDist.description: The shot must be this close to get a perfect dodge. -1 = No distance limit
MaxPerfectDodgeDist.label: Max Perfect Dodge Dist

MaxPerfectDodgeDistance.description: If this is non-negative, then the player must be this close to the attacker when they dodge to receive a perfect dodge.
MaxPerfectDodgeDistance.label: Max Perfect Dodge Distance

MaxPhase.description: What is the minimum phase number to use this combo. Starts from 0.
MaxPhase.label: Max Phase

MaxPitchDiffAtMaxYaw.description: What is the max angle the target can be from the input direction at minimum distance (note Yaw is measured along the aim line plane. Pitch is perpendicular... very much like spherical coordinates since we are aiming on a Sphere)

MaxPitchDiffAtMinYaw.description: What is the max angle the target can be from the input direction at minimum distance (note Yaw is measured along the aim line plane. Pitch is perpendicular... very much like spherical coordinates since we are aiming on a Sphere)

MaxPitchFromEdge_InnerYaw.description: Max degrees a target can be from the very edge of the screen when the camera is pitched to it's max/min amount

MaxPoisonRadius.description: This is the radius of the damage cylinder once all the poison has reached it's max radius.

MaxPreRotateScreenRatio.description: Max Percentage from center to edge of screen to try and put the target

MaxPredictionSpeed.description: This is the max speed used for predicition. If the target is faster than this, his detected speed will be clamped to this.

MaxPredictionSpeedTraversal.description: MaxPredictionSpeedTraversal: This is the max speed used for predicition while target is traversing. If the target is faster than this, his detected speed will be clamped to this.

MaxPredictionSpeedXZ.description: Max amount of target's XZ velocity to use for prediction.

MaxPredictionSpeedY.description: Max amount of target's Y velocity to use for prediction.

MaxPrioTypesLoaded.description: The maximum number of PrioTypes types allowed to have instances loaded at once.

MaxProceduralPitchDown.description: This corresponds to extra amount we are allowed to look down

MaxProceduralPitchUp.description: This corresponds to extra amount we are allowed to look up

MaxPromoteDist.description: Distance from the camera at which a pedestrian group will begin promoting its members.

MaxPromoteDistOffscreen.description: Distance from the camera at which a pedestrian group will begin promoting its members when the group is offscreen.

MaxPullSpeed.description: Maximum speed the hero can travel at while being pulled

MaxPushSpeed.description: How strongly we push at DistForMaxPush

MaxQTEEnemies.description: Max number of enemies that can have a QTE combo attack at a time.
MaxQTEEnemies.label: Num QTE Enemies

MaxRPM.description: When at shift up speed for this gear, this is the RPM.

MaxRadius.description: The final radius to extend to after being hit
MaxRadius.label: Max Radius

MaxRagdollTime.description: If the ragdoll won't settle then we'll pass our ragdoll settle check after this many seconds.

MaxRageMeter.description: The maximum amount of Rage we can accumulate

MaxRaiseSpeed.description: Max speed we raise the bot when the bot is grabbed
MaxRaiseSpeed.label: TargetRaiseSpeed

MaxRange.description: Target must be within this maximum radius from the search source
MaxRange.label: Max Search Range

MaxRangeBottom.description: If the target vertical downward distance is greater than this value, target will not be selected.

MaxRangeTop.description: If target vertical upward distance is greater than this value, target will not be selected.

MaxRangeXZ.description: Max range to the target when target is at minimum angle

MaxRateScale.description: The bot won't rate scale themself higher than this, even it it means the events aren't reached at the same time
MaxRateScale.label: Max Rate Scale

MaxReacts.description: Once we have played this many melee reactions without hitting a Breakout Condition we will break out if we are attacked again.
MaxReacts.label: Max Reacts

MaxRecoveryAnimDistance.description: If the bot uses a Recovery anim, then by default they will take the motion joint of the recovery into account when computing the landing spot. This can be used to limit how much of that motion to consider

MaxReinforceCount.description: Maximum number of reinforcement spawned actors

MaxRelativeReward.description: How many rewards should an instance of this spawner give in total. If negative, always give full rewards.

MaxRemainingTime.description: Make sure the status effect doesn't stay on longer than this after TimeAfterDeath. We'll never increase the amount of time the status effects wanted to be around
MaxRemainingTime.label: Max Remaining Time

MaxRepositionDistance.description: Max distance that kraven can move while repositioning while obscured
MaxRepositionDistance.label: Max Reposition Distance

MaxResidualDistanceAtImpact.description: Max distance due to previous state speed we are able to move by our impact frame. Use -1 for default behavior.

MaxResidualSpeedAtImpact.description: How much speed at impact we are able to retain from our previous state. Use -1 for default behavior.

MaxReverbBlendDistanceScalar.description: Multiplied with Insideness to determine furthest point to portal where reverb blending start to occur.

MaxRoadAngleDiff.description: The maximum angle a road can turn while considered the same direction as the start.

MaxRoll.description: Maximum amount of roll that can be applied to the camera in degrees

MaxRopePoints.description: Maximum number of control points for rope to use

MaxRopes.description: The maximum number of ropes that can be managed at once
MaxRopes.label: Max Ropes

MaxRotationDegrees.description: This is the maximum rotation layer tile can be rotated within a tile in degrees.

MaxRotationSpeed.description: How fast to rotate at max time

MaxRotationSpeedSeconds.description: The maximum speed at which the boat rotates towards its destination in degrees per second
MaxRotationSpeedSeconds.label: Maximum Rotation Speed

MaxRunningLightDistance.description: Running lights will only be turned on while within this distance of the hero. Event name: TrainCarRunningLightsEvent
MaxRunningLightDistance.label: Max Running Light Distance

MaxRushPitchDown.description: Most we are allowed to pitch downward when rushing

MaxRushPitchUp.description: Most we are allowed to pitch upward when rushing

MaxSFXDistance.description: SFX (brakes, turn squeals, moving noises, doors closing warnings, etc.) will stop playing when passing beyond this distance of the hero.
MaxSFXDistance.label: Max SFX Distance

MaxSampleCount.description: It determines the maximum iteration number of raymarching. This option highly impacts the performance.

MaxSampleDistance.description: It determines the maximum sampling distance for raymarching. This option highly impacts the performance. It is recommended to use this option always.

MaxScaleXY.description: Maximum model scale of knot model around spline

MaxScaleZ.description: Maximum model scale of knot model along spline

MaxScreenPointForFOV.description: If an object's max screen area edge is more than this percent away from the center the max fov will be used.

MaxScreenSpaceViewTweak.description: Maximum amount we can tweak the view aim line due to trying to avoid the head

MaxSecondaryTargetOffsetForward.description: How far away can a secondary target be in the primary fire direction

MaxSecondaryTargetOffsetSide.description: How far to the side can a secondary target be. Note that AlwaysIncludeAngle supercedes this value

MaxSecondaryTargetOffsetUp.description: How far away can a secondary target be vertically

MaxSequentialUses.description: If greater then zero then we can't use this attack more than this many times in a row.
MaxSequentialUses.label: Max Sequential Uses

MaxSettleDegs.description: Default region the camera is allowed to float in
MaxSettleDegs.label: Max Settle Degs

MaxSettleHeight.description: Maximum distance we'll travel vertically after arriving

MaxShakeIntensityScale.description: Speeds above MaxShakeLandSpeed cause shake to be scaled by this amount.

MaxShakeLandSpeed.description: Speeds above this cause shake to be scaled by MaxShakeIntensityScale

MaxShotSpeed.description: Max speed Telekinesis object will acclerate to when fired
MaxShotSpeed.label: Max Shot Speed

MaxShowCooldown.description: The maximum amount of time this target will hide for
MaxShowCooldown.label: Max Show Cooldown

MaxSimultaneous.description: How many arcs should we have visible at a given time?
MaxSimultaneous.label: Max Simultaneous

MaxSimultaneousLookers.description: Limit the number of simulataneous looking peds? Negative for unlimited.

MaxSingleTriggerTValue.description: The maximum t value a single trigger can reach when the other trigger is not in the sweet spot.

MaxSlamOffsetBack.description: What's the max target point we tell the bot to slam to behind us. We can find targets at a larger range but we clamp the distance when computing the slam point

MaxSlamOffsetFront.description: What's the max target point we tell the bot to slam to. We can find targets at a larger range but we clamp the distance when computing the slam point

MaxSlideSpeed.description: Limit on how fast we are able to slide into place if we are too far away.

MaxSlotFileSizeMiB.description: Max file size allowed in each slot when splitting the binary payload up in MiB

MaxSlots.description: Max slots to split the binary payload into

MaxSmellAdvanceDistance.description: How far can a smell progress along the line in a single sniff.

MaxSnapAheadTime.description: We don't want to create cases where Sandman naturally reaches a point just before this MandatoryFrame and then barely moves the next frame, so if Sandman would naturally hit a point within this time before the Frame, instead have Sandman go a bit farther to hit this Frame instead
MaxSnapAheadTime.label: Max Snap Ahead Time

MaxSpawnAmmo.description: For our regenerating spawn ammo, cap the number of stocks held to this. Negative value disables the ammo limits.
MaxSpawnAmmo.label: Max Spawn Ammo

MaxSpawnCount.description: Maximum number of birds to spawn around the hero.
MaxSpawnCount.label: Max Spawned Birds

MaxSpawnCountMax.description: The max value for the maximum number of active/alive critters from this spawner.
MaxSpawnCountMax.label: Max alive count (Max)

MaxSpawnDistance.description: Birds may spawn on ledge paths that are at most this distance away from hero.
MaxSpawnDistance.label: Max Spawn Distance

MaxSpawnDistanceOffscreen.description: Trains must spawn within this distance of the camera if off-screen.
MaxSpawnDistanceOffscreen.label: Max Spawn Distance Offscreen

MaxSpawnPeriod.description: After a bird is spawned, the system may wait at most this amount of time before spawning another.
MaxSpawnPeriod.label: Max Spawn Period

MaxSpawnRadius.description: Optional control for max distance a spawn point can be from the player to spawn (0 means not used)

MaxSpawnedBirds.description: Try to have this many birds spawned in at any given time.
MaxSpawnedBirds.label: Max Spawned Birds

MaxSpawnedInstances.description: The number of instances within this type allowed to be spawned at once. Negative value for unrestricted

MaxSpeedAtRagdollTime.description: Max speed we are allowed to be when we reach the AnimRagdollEvent. We will automatically compute a minimum deceleration to use to hit this speed target so we are never going faster than this speed when we ragdoll

MaxSpeedBack.description: Maximum m/s to try and apply to steering backward

MaxSpeedForward.description: Maximum m/s to try and apply to steering forward

MaxSpeedHorz.description: Maximum m/s to try and apply to steering left-right

MaxSpeedLeftRight.description: The max speed along the left-right axis of the actor
MaxSpeedLeftRight.label: Max Speed Left-Right

MaxSpeedTeam.description: The fastest this jump is allowed to go, when being used for an automatic team takedown

MaxSpeedUpDown.description: The max speed along the up-down axis of the actor
MaxSpeedUpDown.label: Max Speed Up-Down

MaxSpeedXZ.description: Don't display this message when the hero is moving faster than this speed horizontally.

MaxSpinRate.description: Maximum anim rate we'll ever use

MaxSpins.description: How many times should the bot spin around before doing the throw
MaxSpins.label: Max Spins

MaxSpreadLookers.description: Limit the number of simulataneous looking peds? Negative for unlimited.

MaxStacks.description: The max bonus damage stacks. Max bonus damage = DamageGainPercent * MaxStacks

MaxStacksSpawnActor.description: This is the actor that will be spawned when the player gets to the final stage in the symbiote status.

MaxStacksSpawnActorDestroyTimeout.description: This is a failsafe time out.
