When we want to stop the max stacks minigame we send out an event to the MaxStacksSpawnActor and wait for it to respond that it's in a good state to be destroyed. This time out will throw an error if we didn't hear from the actor that it was destroyed. This is to help track down bugs.

MaxStareTime.description: -1 disables looking away. Maximum amount of time bot will look at person talking everytime they start staring
MaxStareTime.label: Max Stare Time

MaxStartingAllowableCurvatureDist.description: smaller the number, the larger the starting allowable curvature

MaxStationarySpeed.description: While the hero is below this speed (not including external motion), the hero is considered stationary for the purposes of the tentacle.
MaxStationarySpeed.label: Max Stationary Speed for Tentacle

MaxStatusDistance.description: Maximum distance from the camera that the actor can be at to report status to the HUD (no further than this distance).
MaxStatusDistance.label: Max Status Distance

MaxStepSize.description: It determines the maximum raymarching step size. The final step size will be close to this value if the view direction is close to the horizon.

MaxStepUpHeight.description: Maximum height the ledge we vault over can be

MaxStickAngleToVault.description: Max angle stick can be from direction to vault to vault without sprinting

MaxStickInpuAtMinTime.description: Ramp max stick input between this value and 1.0f over TimeForMaxStickInput interval

MaxStopDistance.description: The closest point on the roadmap to the destination must be within this distance, if not the search stops and signals OnTimeoutOrError.

MaxStopDistanceNav.description: Max Path Distance for the DoNavCheck condition.

MaxStoredFinishers.description: How many finishers can one bank

MaxStretchReductionPercent.description: When the rope increases in length, how much of that increase should be applied to reducing bend displacement

MaxStruggleTime.description: How long before we force fail the player. This is the total amount of time the player has to mash the button. (-1 means never fail)

MaxStunTime.description: If Venom is stunned for this long without receiving any damage, have him recover and reset him to max allowed health for his current phase
MaxStunTime.label: Max Stun Time

MaxTakedownDistance.description: Sable must be at least this close to an enemy bot before attempting to take them down.

MaxTargetCount.description: How many targets can we find when we detonate

MaxTargetDistance.description: If the target is further than this value, no shuffles will occur. The default value is to only allow shuffles at close range. If the value is negative, the max distance is infinite.

MaxTargetFollowSpeed.description: If the target moves fast than this many meters per second, cap our follow speed.

MaxTargetHalfAngleXZ.description: Half angle of the horizontal wedge used for targeting

MaxTargetHalfAngleY.description: Optional half angle of the max vertical angle to the target

MaxTargetOffset.description: Maximum offset from desired target position

MaxTargetRange.description: Maximum distance a target can be

MaxTargetRangeDown.description: How far below us a target can be

MaxTargetRangeUp.description: How high above us a target can be

MaxTargetRangeY.description: How far above us are we allowed to grab targets

MaxTargetingDuration.description: Time we spend looking for an initial target to orient to

MaxTargetlessDropHeight.description: Maximum height the ledge we vault over can be

MaxTargetlessTravelDist.description: Maximum height the ledge we vault over can be

MaxTargets.description: Max number of bots to target and pull. Must be <=16
MaxTargets.label: Max Targets

MaxTargetsToHit.description: Arc through this many total targets, replacing the value in the ability's base prius

MaxTetherDistance.description: The maximum distance away from this actor the player can be and still be connected.

MaxThrowablesYanked.description: Max number of throwables to yank. Hard cap of 16 throwables, contact GP if you need more.

MaxTiltSpeed.description: The speed (degrees per second) the camera will tilt towards the selected weakspot at the MaxTiltSpeedDistance from the animated camera's forward.

MaxTiltSpeedDistance.description: The distance (in camera space) where the camera tilts towards the selected weakspot at MaxTiltSpeed.

MaxTime.description: Max time at which this resolution is forced to execute. Negative to disable
MaxTime.label: Max Time

MaxTimeBeforeReposition.description: The maximum amount of time before the bot will reposition to their ideal waiting position in the fight ring. We become more willing to move the longer it has been since we last moved.

MaxTimeBetweenMoves.description: The maximum amount of time that must pass before this bot can move again.

MaxTimeBetweenPresses.description: If the ReSpin button hasn't been pressed in this long, we'll immediately end spinning

MaxTimeBetweenShots.description: The maximum amount of time between shots (will be minimum if lower than Min)

MaxTimeBetweenTaps.description: Maximum time between taps to count as a double-tap

MaxTimeGainPerKOApplyCount.description: Puts a limit on the number of times KOs can add to our rage time when active

MaxTimeLossFromDamagePerHit.description: Optinally caps how much we can deplete the timer due to a single damage event

MaxTimeOffScreen.description: Maximum time a bot will spend perched offscreen before they'll try to reposition to a perch on screen. If no perch is available, they'll stay where they are.
MaxTimeOffScreen.label: Maximum Perch Time (Off Screen)

MaxTimeOnWall.description: How long to stick to wall before auto falling off

MaxTimeScale.description: Time passes at this rate for this actor when the angle between the velocity and the XZ plane is more than the MaxTimeScaleAngle.

MaxTimeScaleAngle.description: (Degrees) Lerp the actor time scale based on the angle between the velocity and the XZ plane. At this angle, use the MaxTimeScale.

MaxTimeSinceAttackable.description: How long to track targets after the hero can no longer attack this target (e.g. goes behind collision)

MaxToPreSpawn.description: Initial number of each possible Resource actor to pre-spawn
MaxToPreSpawn.label: Initial Actor count

MaxTotalBounces.description: Shot will stop bouncing if it bounces this many times total

MaxTotalEnemyCount.description: Number of known enemies must not be more than this
MaxTotalEnemyCount.label: Max Total Enemy Count

MaxTotalTime.description: The most time we'll ever wait for the event

MaxTracerPingDelay.description: Maximum delay between tagged enemy despawning and result of trace showing up

MaxTrackAngularVelocity.description: When traveling at MaxSpeed, how many degrees per second should the sheet rotate about it's side-axis to track its target?

MaxTrafficRemovalTestDist.description: Max Distance to from stop point to do traffic detection

MaxTrainCarsPerTrain.description: Maximum number of cars per train.
MaxTrainCarsPerTrain.label: Max Cars Per Train

MaxTrains.description: Maximum number of trains that can be active at any given time.
MaxTrains.label: Max Trains

MaxTranslationXZ.description: How far the target can move laterally before we auto detach

MaxTranslationXZForMaxSpeedT.description: Maximum XZ translation distance at minimum speed threshold

MaxTranslationXZForMinSpeedT.description: Maximum XZ translation distance at minimum speed threshold

MaxTranslationY.description: How far the target can move vertically before we auto detach

MaxTravelDist.description: Maximum height the ledge we vault over can be

MaxTurbinesSpawned.description: The amount of turbines that can be shot out.

MaxTurnRate.description: How many degrees per second the strafer is allowed to rotate
MaxTurnRate.label: Max Turn Rate

MaxTypesLoaded.description: Maximum number of crime types loaded at once

MaxUnforcedPositionIterations.description: When calculating where to place a truck on the track curve, iterate at most this many times. Does not include forced iterations from changing track curves. A higher value means more accuracy at the cost of taking longer to calculate.
MaxUnforcedPositionIterations.label: Max Unforced Position Iterations

MaxUniqueItems.description: Maximum number of different items that this inventory can store.
MaxUniqueItems.label: Max Unique Items

MaxUpdateDistance.description: Maxmimum distance to which animation is updated (0.0 always tries to update).

MaxUploadFileSizeMiB.description: Max total file size allowed to be uploaded in MiB

MaxUseCount.description: This entry will disable itself after the player uses the action associated (if there is one). 0 means do not disable.

MaxUsers.description: Only return true if the clue has fewer active users than this value.
MaxUsers.label: Max Users

MaxValidAngleDegrees.description: Max angle (degrees) between Volume Forward and Volume-Position-To-Bot Direction to consider the player hidden. Value less than 0 means all angles are valid.
MaxValidAngleDegrees.label: Max Valid Angle

MaxValue.description: Morph Target Name must be at most this value to apply the anim filter
MaxValue.label: Max Value

MaxVaultToVictimDist.description: FarRange controls max distance to the vault. This controls max dist from vault to victim.

MaxVerticalRandomMultiplier.description: Maximum random variation applied to height

MaxVictims.description: The maximum number of Targets the jump has to hit to award the max cooldown refund
MaxVictims.label: Max Victims

MaxViewAngleForZipTarget.description: Maximum angle from the view line our zip target can be to be valid

MaxViewablePercent.description: We interpolate from 0 to Viewable Percent Bonus as the percentage of our frustum that we can see goes from Min to Max Viewable Percent
MaxViewablePercent.label: Max Viewable Percent

MaxVirtualPosBlendDistanceScalar.description: Multiplied with insideness to create distance at which virtual position is at 100% and actual position is at 0%

MaxWaitAfterImpactTime.description: The maximum amount of timew e will wait for in incoming attack to hit us after the ideal damage time of the attack has been reached. Use -1 to ignore

MaxWaitDuration.description: Abort if this move has been in the waiting to start state for this long without starting. -1 means never abort
MaxWaitDuration.label: Max Wait Duration

MaxWaitForImpactTime.description: The maximum amount of time we will wait for the incoming attack to hit us in total.

MaxWaitForUndodgableImpactTime.description: Used for Special Undodgables... The maximum amount of time we will wait for the incoming attack to hit us. After this amount of time we will automatically start the parry

MaxWallAngleFromAttackDirection.description: Max angle to the wall impact position measured from the attack direction.

MaxWallCollisionAngle.description: Max angle we search for collision behind a target to initiate a wall/railing attack

MaxWallCollisionRange.description: Max distance we search for collision behind a target to initiate a wall/railing attack

MaxWideDegs.description: How much the camera cam pitch to look at a high priority target
MaxWideDegs.label: Max Wide Degs

MaxYankHeavies.description: Maximum times we can yank before the line automatically breaks. Use -1 for infinite

MaxYankTowardsRangeXZ.description: Max distance to yank a bot all the way towards us (-1 defaults to full web-strike range)

MaxYankTowardsRangeY.description: Max distance to yank a bot from the ground into the air (use positive values, negative values mean use full web-strike range)

MaxYanks.description: Maximum times we can yank before the line automatically breaks. Use -1 for infinite

MaxYawDiff.description: Max yaw diff from facing in degrees.
MaxYawDiff.label: Max Yaw Diff From Facing

MaxYawDiffAtHorizontalInput.description: Exclude targets that would cause the camera to rotate this much in Yaw when input is horizontal

MaxYawDiffAtVerticalInput.description: Exclude targets that would cause the camera to rotate this much in Yaw when input is vertical

MaxYawToRotate.description: Ignore rotation if we are greater than this many degrees of the desired rotation

MaxZoomTime.description: Time it takes to go from min to max zoom when at max analog movement.

MaximumCollisionPolysPerNonstaticMesh.description: Error on models that have mesh collision with more than this many tris, unless they are static-only.
MaximumCollisionPolysPerNonstaticMesh.label: Max Collision Tris

MaximumHealthMultiplier.description: Multiply venom gains by this much when HP is at the maximum.

MaximumMomentum.description: When non-negative, momentum meter caps to this

MaximumPower.description: The maximum power from the cannon that the water will shoot
MaximumPower.label: Maximum Power

MaximumRange.description: The maximum range from the cannon that the water will travel
MaximumRange.label: Maximum Range

MaximumScale.description: The scale of the game when fully zoomed in.

MaximumTargetShowCooldown.description: The maximum time between showing targets
MaximumTargetShowCooldown.label: Maximum Target Show Cooldown

MaximumTargetShowDuration.description: The maximum duration the player has to hit a target
MaximumTargetShowDuration.label: Maximum Target Show Duration

MaximumValue.description: The maximum output value possible. 0 or less means no max

MayaEndFrame.description: Last frame in the animation to freeze the skeleton.

MayaExportInfo.description: This contains information used when the actor is exported from Maya.
MayaExportInfo.label: Maya Export Info

MayaName.description: maya name used in name spaces.

MayaNameSpace.description: The name of namespace in Maya.

MayaNameTrackTags.description: A set of data that defines given maya name and the track tags associated with it. most customized to least customized order

MayaNamespace.description: Namespace, in Maya, to associate with this actor assignment.

MayaPath.description: maya file referenced into the scene for the MayaNameSpace in ref editor

MayaPaths.description: list of full paths to maya files

MayaPlayBackCompensate.description: When music is scored with maya play back for i29 and i31

MayaStartFrame.description: First frame in the animation to freeze the skeleton.

MeanderArea.description: If set, the area we should meander in.
MeanderArea.label: (Opt.) Meander Area

MeanderDistMax.description: The maximum distance we can wander when meandering.
MeanderDistMax.label: Meander Dist: Max

MeanderDistMin.description: The minimum distance we can wander when meandering.
MeanderDistMin.label: Meander Dist: Min

MeanderIdleTimeMax.description: The maximim time to wait before meandering somewhere else.
MeanderIdleTimeMax.label: Idle Time: Max

MeanderIdleTimeMin.description: The minimum time to wait before meandering somewhere else.
MeanderIdleTimeMin.label: Idle Time: Min

MeanderRadius.description: How far from this actor the critter may roam. Set to -1 to use the bounding sphere radius.
MeanderRadius.label: Meander Radius

MedIntensityThreshold.description: Threshold of transitioning between low and medium intensity
MedIntensityThreshold.label: Medium Intensity Threshold

MedMinimumPlaytime.description: The amount of time the medium intensity state will play for without transitioning down.
MedMinimumPlaytime.label: Medium Minimum Playtime

MediumCameraShakeConfig.description: Camera shake config for hitting a medium object.

MediumImpactStrength.description: What percent of the animated joint tracking do we apply for a medium attack.
MediumImpactStrength.label: Medium Impact Strength

MediumMaxTimeToTargetLocation.label: Medium Max Time To Target Location

MediumMinTimeToTargetLocation.label: Medium Min Time To Target Location

MediumRangeFilterDist.description: Optional ability to set short/medium/long range anim filter as distance measured to the vault point.

MeleeAir.description: Used if hero started or finished their attack in the air

MeleeDamageMultiplier.description: How much melee damage the hero deals while at this level as a ratio to the move's base damage. 1 = use move's base damage.
MeleeDamageMultiplier.label: Melee Damage Multiplier

MeleeDefault.description: Default value for attacks that awared energy

MeleeEnergyCostPerDamage.label: Passive Shield Energy Cost Per Melee Damage

MeleeFlatHeightTolerance.description: How far off from the MeleeHeightLocator can be be and still get a flat pitch anim filter
MeleeFlatHeightTolerance.label: Melee Flat Height Tolerance

MeleeHeightLocator.description: The locator or joint position we'll calculate the offset height from
MeleeHeightLocator.label: Melee Height Locator

MeleeInteractable.description: Whether this turret will be melee interactable.

MeleeInteractableData.description: Data for if weapon is thrown as attack. If shot configs not set, defaults to one on Hero's Melee Config

MeleeMoveDragDecayDelay.description: How long current drag strength holds steady
MeleeMoveDragDecayDelay.label: Melee Drag Decay Delay

MeleeMoveDragHitsMax.description: Number of melee hits when drag is at full strength
MeleeMoveDragHitsMax.label: Melee Drag Hits Min

MeleeMoveDragHitsMin.description: Number of melee hits when drag starts getting applied
MeleeMoveDragHitsMin.label: Melee Drag Hits Min

MeleePause.description: If jobs are paused from a standard melee hit or air launcher, it'll be for this many seconds
MeleePause.label: Melee Pause

MeleePredictAheadTime.description: How many seconds should we estimate into the future for setting the GripHand anim filter to Left or Right
MeleePredictAheadTime.label: Melee Predict Ahead Time

MeleePromptLocator.description: Optional locator name to place the melee prompt at. Defautls to TargetData Location 0

MeleePromptOffset.description: Optional offset in local space to the target to adjust the melee prompt by

MeleeRage.description: Used for melee attacks when the hero is in rage mode

MemberCountAttackJobCooldownMultipliers.label: Member Count Attack Job Cooldown Multipliers

MenuName.description: This must match the menu name given in the Menu entry.

Menus.description: The first given menu will be the one we start on.

MergeItemPriorities.description: If true. items are tested as if they are one big item group, and just ordered by distance.

MeshTendrilUvRepeatCountV.description: The number of times the texture repeats in the V axis per meter

MeshTentacleUvRepeatCountV.description: The number of times the texture repeats in the V axis per meter

Message.description: The type of potential problem that may have occured with dialog.

MessageData.description: Data related to the message box.

MessageEntry.description: Localization tag and weighting for each message option to display.

MessageLocTag.description: Localization tag of the message to display.

MessageType.description: Message type of the message to show. Use kTutorial for a message about an action with controls. Use kHelp for more general messages.

Messages.description: Any non-error (info/warning) output messages during command execution.

MetersPerVehicleOverride.description:
Sequences inside of this volume will have their desired meters per vehicle overridden. For readability in editor and when debugging, please enclose ENTIRE sequences, not just head nodes.
Example usage would be setting this to 10m per vehicle on a 100m sequence would mean the target vehicle count is 10.
Leave at -1 for default density.

MidPointAngle.description: Angle from cam-forward to bend blended direction to MidPointValue angle

MidPointLower.description: A volume for the sync point that contacts in the lower area of the crack

MidPointUpper.description: A volume for the sync point that contacts in the upper area of the crack

MidPointValue.description: Applied input angle relative to cam-forward when true angle is MidPointAngle

MidTones.description: A log-space adjustment applied to the mid-tones of the image.
MidTones.label: Mid Tones

MidTonesSat.description: Adjusts the saturation in the mid-tones of the image. Positive values increase the saturation. Negative values decrease the saturation.
MidTonesSat.label: Mid Tones Sat

MiddleDuration.description: Default duration for Middle. For Activation this can get overriden by markup on the animation

MidnightModeRTPCName.description: Name of RTPC to be used when midnight mode is toggled

MidpointAdjustment.description: Offsets the target midpoint used by local tone mapping from the global adapted luminance midpoint.
MidpointAdjustment.label: Midpoint Adjustment

MilesAbilityDisplayOrder.description: The order we will display the slotted abilities in for Miles Spider-Man

MilesActive_Angle.description: How much rotation to apply to the heroes when Miles is active hero.

MilesActive_XOffset.description: How far to move the heroes Left/Right when Miles is active hero.

MilesActive_ZOffset.description: How far to movce the heroes Forward/Backward when Miles is active hero.

MilesCapturedWorldState.description: At least one world state in this list must be active.

MilesCinematic.description: Optional: The cinematic to play if the pause-menu hero is Miles.

MilesDollCineTarget.description: ActorA-H, what script target to use for possession of the Miles paperdoll actor.

MilesHeroDollData.description: Additional hero doll data for the Miles hero doll.

MilesLine.description: Line to play if the player is Miles.

Min.description: This field is only for use in the ui code to inform the color grade picker what the intensity maximum is.
Min.label: Minimum

MinActionStartTime.description: Optional ability to delay how early the 'action' related to the input starts. By default it happens when button is pressed

MinActivatingDist.description: This is how far the shot has to be from the shooter before it can activate. If <= 0 then this check is disabled

MinAheadDistance.description: At our min speed, we project ahead this distance.
MinAheadDistance.label: Min Ahead Distance

MinAimAngle.description: The player cannot aim the lure lower than this angle below the XZ plane.

MinAimSteadyTime.description: How long should this bot need to have steady aim before it can fire? -1 to not require steady aim.
MinAimSteadyTime.label: Minimum Aim Steady Time

MinAimTime.description: The aim circle must be on-screen for at least this amount of time before the lure can be thrown. Releasing the button before this will cancel the throw.

MinAlignedVelocity.description: If the dodge ever goes this fast in the direction the hero was going leading into the dodge, we maintain that speed coming out of it. There's a middle ground of speed the hero can move at where it looks weird to speed up to make the dodge and then slow down to the original speed
MinAlignedVelocity.label: Min Aligned Velocity

MinAlliesToUse.description: If non-zero then there must be at least this many attackers (including yourself) to use this combo.
MinAlliesToUse.label: Min Allies To Use

MinAllowedTargeters.description: Minimum targeters can the super ally can have
MinAllowedTargeters.label: Min Allowed Targeters

MinAngleConfidenceBias.description: Bias to apply when angle is hardest to judge (pushing left/right of the camera). Lower number favors distance.

MinAngleDistanceBiasXZ.description: How much farther per degree of angle offset this target is perceived

MinAngleForTurn.description: How much the curve angle must change to be considered a turn.

MinAnimRate.description: Minimum rate that the fly anim will play.
MinAnimRate.label: Min Loop Anim Rate

MinAnimRateScaleByDistance.description: Minimum effect dodging longer distances can have on anim rate

MinAreaCastRadius.description: Minimum radius for an area ray. This overrides any calculated values set on the actor.

MinAscentHeight.description: How high to ascent at minium range

MinAssaultModeTime.description: Minimum amount of time we'll take away for activating the mode

MinAttachDistance.description: Base attach distance to stick to walls, works from any in-air state.

MinAttachSpeed.description: If target is moving below this speed, disable attachment

MinAttackDist.description: Minimum distance at which Venom will attack the player.

MinAutoDodgeDist.description: None of the auto dodging values apply unless the bot is this close to the shot
MinAutoDodgeDist.label: Min Auto Dodge Dist

MinAwayFromTargetAngle.description: When initially traveling at MinSpeed, how many degrees offset from the target should we start the shot at. This gives time for the AngularVelocity to curve it back in

MinBeepInterval.description: The minimum amount of time between hot-cold beeps.

MinBirdSeparation.description: How far birds must be from each other.
MinBirdSeparation.label: Min Bird Separation

MinBirdSpacing.description: There must be at least this much space between birds on a ledge path.
MinBirdSpacing.label: Min Bird Spacing

MinBonusDistance.description: Minimum amount of bonus distance we apply to Far Distance. Use -1 for default behavior

MinBonusHeight.description: Always ensure we travel at least this amount upwards (we can go more if we're close to the ground or we're already moving up fast)

MinBotAttachedHeightOffset.description: Minimum height offset for attached secondary bots relative to the attachment line

MinBotAttachedSideOffset.description: Minimum lateral offset for attached secondary bots

MinBounceHeight.description: Bounces that want to go less than this height will be rejected and we'll just flop

MinCadenceForHits.description: How much time is allowed between each hit till we reset or fail
MinCadenceForHits.label: Hit Cadence

MinCamDist.description: Minimum distance the camera cam get

MinCharge.description: Minimum charge percent before a charge jump can be executed

MinChaseSpeed.description: Minimum speed this actor is allowed to go.
MinChaseSpeed.label: Min Chase Speed

MinClearSpace.description: If we're doing LOS checks, snap the dest points out far enough so we're centered on a LOS passing area at least this long. Otherwise we might still be partially occluded if a LOS ray just barely got past the edge of a big obstruction
MinClearSpace.label: Min Clear Space

MinCollisionSpeed.description: Must be going this fast to take collision damage

MinComboLength.description: Attack combo must be at least this length to count towards this benchmark.
MinComboLength.label: Min Combo Length

MinCooldown.description: Min time before Miles can use his invisibility again

MinCooldownDistance.description: Distance cooldown mult will be at 1.0 at this distance or less from last spawn

MinCount.description: Minimum pois needed to be found to start the event.
MinCount.label: Min Count

MinCrimesComplete.description: The minimum number of crimes of a single type to be complete, to use this set of Chance Values

MinCrowdedTime.description: We have to be nearby the required number of enemies for this many seconds before we're considered in the thick of combat
MinCrowdedTime.label: Min Crowded Time

MinDamageMultColor.description: Color of the indicator when our damage multiplier is minimal. Lerps to the max color and our multiplier increases.
MinDamageMultColor.label: Min Damage Mult Color

MinDeactivateScalingDistance.description: AutoDeactivateTime cooldown mult will be at 1.0 at this distance or less from crime

MinDeactivationCost.description: When Rage Mode is deactivated, we guarantee the player will have lost at least this much meter.

MinDeathsToSpawn.description: Minimum deaths needed to spawn ammo drops

MinDelayBetweenSpawns.description: Used to control the minimum time between spawns

MinDeleteDistOffScreen.description: If a bot is this far from the camera and isn't rendering, efficiently prevent them from plummeting to death by removing them from existence.

MinDeleteRadius.description: Minimum distance from the player AI must be to auto-deleted in preference of a better spawn candidate.

MinDescentHeight.description: Descent will do straight line path to the target. Using a descent height can curve this very slightly

MinDiffractionBlendDistanceScalar.description: Multiplied with Insideness to determine the distance where max diffraction values are applied.

MinDissolveDelay.description: Min Delay to start disolving the body based on the DissolveType

MinDissolveDuration.description: Min duration for the dissolve to happen

MinDist.description: How far away from the target do we have to be?
MinDist.label: Minimum Distance

MinDistAngleTol.description: At close distance, if the target aim angle is larger than this, we will give up snapping
MinDistAngleTol.label: Min Distance Angle Tolerance

MinDistBetweenPoints.description: The minimum distance between the randomly generated positions.

MinDistForPoint.description: Minimum distance points can be tested

MinDistFromEnemies.description: The min distance from our enemies where we will generate goto positions.

MinDistPreviousScoring.description: The smaller value past which points will be weighted the most

MinDistToTarget.description: Target must be at least this distance away to use this move
MinDistToTarget.label: Minimum Distance To Target

MinDistToTargetWhenDescending.description: When hanging from the ceiling, this is the closest distance we can get to the target vertically

MinDistToTop.description: When the drone jetpacks close THIS close (meters) to collision above it, its vertical speed will start blending to <= 0

MinDistToUpdate.description: The distance the hero has to move from a previously updated position in order to request a new update.

MinDistance.description: If this is greater then 0 then our target must be this close to continue the combo into this move.
MinDistance.label: Min Distance

MinDistanceAllowed.description: The closest we want to allow us to get to our target

MinDistanceBetweenShieldAndTarget.description: How close can our shield get to our target. Negative values mean penetration

MinDistanceForLongRangeTransition.description: Camera distance from the bot at this many metera and closer will ONLY be using the circulatory actor to show awarensss. Blends when between min/max

MinDistanceFromHero.description: Minimum distance from the hero to back up
MinDistanceFromHero.label: Min Distance From Hero

MinDistanceFromStreet.description: The critter may not move closer to a street than this.
MinDistanceFromStreet.label: Min Distance from Street

MinDistanceToCamera.description: Targets within this distance to the camera are ignored

MinDistanceToGround.description: The closest we allow us to get to the ground while doing a move

MinDistanceToSkipDepthTest.description: We want the circulatory system to render through everything, but this is the minimum distance the camera must be from the bot for it to render over everything. -1 means there is no minimum.

MinDistanceToStart.description: If a vehicle comes to a stop, it shouldn't start moving again as soon as it has any amount of distance left to travel, the start/stop jankiness would look bad. Wait until it can move at least a short distance.

MinDoorOpenTime.description: The minimum time to keep the doors open before closing.

MinDriverTime.description: The minimum time that needs to pass in the driver to play out, otherwise we'll destroy it.
MinDriverTime.label: Min Driver time

MinDropRate.description: Lowest possible drop rate the system can reach

MinDuration.description: Minimum play duration for this sound event (in seconds).

MinDynamicForce.description: Minimum force exerted on the model instance before it starts reacting.
MinDynamicForce.label: Min Dynamic Force

MinEjectConeAngle.description: Force the impact direction into a cone of this size

MinElevation.description: Only spawn landing birds if the hero is above this height.
MinElevation.label: Min Elevation

MinEndDistanceToWall.description: Try and make it so the move doesn't take us any closer to a wall than this amount by move end

MinEndDistanceToWallBoss.description: Try and make it so the move doesn't take us any closer to a wall than this amount by move end when the target is a boss

MinEnemyCount.description: Number of known enemies must be at least this AND within the shape
MinEnemyCount.label: Min Enemy Count

MinEnemyDist.description: At this distance we use SetMinCamDist
MinEnemyDist.label: Min Enemy Dist

MinEnemyInShapeCount.description: Min number of enemies that must be in the shape
MinEnemyInShapeCount.label: Min Enemy In Shape Count

MinEnergy.description: Minimum energy required to trigger the move
MinEnergy.label: Min Energy

MinEngagedTime.description: Don't call until the group has been engaged for at least this many seconds
MinEngagedTime.label: Min Engaged Time

MinExtents.description: Vector that defines the maximum distance, NEGATIVELY, along each axis we can translate from the actors original location
MinExtents.label: Min Extents

MinFacingAngle.description: This is the minimum angle that the player can face away from this interact and it still be available.
MinFacingAngle.label: Min Facing Angle

MinFacingThreshold.description: If we're this close to our target on XY, prevent our facing from flickering as we minutely shift around the center
MinFacingThreshold.label: Min Facing Threshold

MinFireWait.description: The minimum time to wait between fires.
MinFireWait.label: Min wait between fires

MinFiringDistance.description: Define a distance which we consider close range
MinFiringDistance.label: Close Range Distance

MinFlatPathLength.description: Minimum length of the path where we jump between navigation that wouldn't require a clue
MinFlatPathLength.label: Min Flat Path Length

MinFleeDistance.description: When picking a flee direction, the the bird must be able to fly at least this distance in its chosen direction.

MinFleeReactionTime.description: When about to flee, each bird will randomly wait at least this amount of time before fleeing.

MinFlyingRepoDist.description: Min Distance To Do Flying Reposition

MinForceCleanupDistance.description: When the event is completely behind us, if it is beyond this distance, force cleanup
MinForceCleanupDistance.label: Min Force Cleanup Distance

MinForwardStickSpeed.description: Minimum speed when pushing the stick in the direction of motion

MinFuturePathRefillDistance.description: Refill the track queue if the end of the queue is within this distance + interlock range + stopping distance of the front of the train. Must be smaller than the max refill distance.

MinGenericChunks.description: Min Num Generic chunks to come off
MinGenericChunks.label: Min Generic Chunks

MinGraceDuration.description: The smallest grace period we're willing to give, since even momentary grace can cause active attacks to be aborted
MinGraceDuration.label: Min Grace Duration

MinGroundDistance.description: We'll always switch to the grounded driver on a foot, when the bot itself is grounded and the distance between the foot locators is less than this distance
MinGroundDistance.label: Min Ground Distance

MinHealth.description: Spawn when health is between MinHealth and MaxHealth (0-1)

MinHealthPercentOnActivation.description: Heal the player up to this much when Rage Mode starts

MinHeight.description: The minimum height of the terrain (in meters), used for establishing where 0 should be.
MinHeight.label: Min Firework Height

MinHeightAboveGroundForAirRating.description: Minimum height above the ground in order to treat ourselves as 'In Air' for height rating

MinHeightBoostedFullPromoteLimitDist.description: Scaled by the Min and MaxOnscreenRangeBoostHeight and appended to MinPromoteDist. Group promotion limits are scaled with their distance to camera (full when at MinPromoteDist, 0 at MaxPromoteDist). This appends to MinPromoteDist (when onscreen) to allow distant, yet onscreen groups to promote closer to their limits. Note this doesn't prevent promotion when less than MinPromoteDist + this, only when less than MinPromoteDist

MinHeroDistance.description: Required distance from the hero for a location to be allowed to refill
MinHeroDistance.label: Min Hero Distance

MinHeroHeight.description: Only show this message when the hero is above this height.

MinHeroToCeilingDistForLongRangeAnims.description: If vertical distance from the hero to the ceiling is less then this distance will use the shorter range anims

MinHorizontalRandomMultiplier.description: Minimum random variation applied to distance

MinHoverHeightAboveGround.description: The minimum height we're willing to hover above the ground.

MinIdealDistFromHero.description: The min distance the bot should ideally stay from the hero.

MinIdealPathLength.description: The ideal minimum length a path can be to a new position. This will help the bot favor mid-range repositions. Note: This isn't the distance from point A->B. It's the length of the path she'll take to get there.

MinIdleTime.description: Minimum amount of time bot will not look at anything in the environment
MinIdleTime.label: Min Idle Time

MinInViewActivateDist.description: Minimum distance from the camera under which a in-view pedestrian group will switch from placeholder models to real pedestrians.

MinInitialSpeed.description: Initial speed at minimum range. WARNING: using this with MinPeakSpeed can cause MinTime/MaxTime to be violated

MinInterval.description: The shortest the interval can get
MinInterval.label: Min Interval

MinIntroTimeToImpact.description: When rate scaling our intro to when impact is going to happen, don't ever let impact per perceived longer than this. This helps prevent rate scaling too slow. This value is only used if the animation has a AnimScaleDriverRateOffEvent on it (meaning there are trailing frames that can be used for idling as we wait for impact)

MinJetpackTime.description: Even if player stops thrusting, thrusters will continue to be activated for this minimum amount of time.

MinJumpDistance.description: A preferred minimum distance between perches.

MinJumpDownDistanceXZ.description: The minimum horizontal distance the critter must cover when jumping down.
MinJumpDownDistanceXZ.label: Min Jump Down Distance XZ

MinJumpDownPauseTime.description: The minimum amount of time the critter idles after turning around, but before jumping down.
MinJumpDownPauseTime.label: Jump Down Min Pause Time

MinJumpWeight.description: A value for how much to weigh the distance preference.

MinLAPStareTime.description: Minimum amount of time bot will look at anything in the environment
MinLAPStareTime.label: Min POI Stare Time

MinLandHeightOffset.description: How far below the target can we land

MinLean.description: Min value on the Lean anim var

MinLength.description: How long the barrier must be to be valid

MinLevel.description: Minimum percentage full of our total focus that is valid for this condition passing

MinLifetime.description: The shortest length of time any component arc will stay visible for
MinLifetime.label: Min Lifetime

MinLinkInfluenceHitAngle.description: Computes the angle between the link direction and the original fire direction, then applies up to this amount to the hit direction

MinLodDistance.description: The distance at which strands are rendered at max lod settings.
MinLodDistance.label: Min LoD Distance

MinLookChunks.description: Min Num Attached chunks to come off
MinLookChunks.label: Min Look Chunks

MinLookSwaps.description: Min Num Look Swaps to perform
MinLookSwaps.label: Min Look Swap

MinMomentum.description: Min value on the Momentum anim var

MinMoveCount.description: Optionally only apply this entry when the global move count is at least this value
MinMoveCount.label: Min Move Count To Be Valid

MinNearbyEnemies.description: The number of nearby enemies required before we can consider the player in the thick of combat
MinNearbyEnemies.label: Min Nearby Enemies

MinNotAttackableDelay.description: When the target is attack immune, we'll keep ticking down our delays, but we'll make sure it's never below this value
MinNotAttackableDelay.label: Min Not Attackable Delay

MinNumberOfAttacks.description: Minimum number of attacks a bot should do while perched before repositioning.
MinNumberOfAttacks.label: Minimum Number of Attacks

MinOfViewDeactivateDist.description: Minimum distance from the camera beyond which an out-of-view pedestrian group will revert its members to placeholder models.

MinOnscreenRangeBoostHeight.description: Camera Y Height is compared against these min/max values to lerp the MaxHeightBoostedPromoteDist, which is appended to MaxPromoteDist

MinOverheadForTakeoff.description: To enter the jetpacking state, the collision overhead must be at least this high. The value has careful interplay with MinDistToTop and InitialVertSpeed, so test in 'low-ceiling areas' such as tight vents

MinPathHeight.description: Min height that path will draw

MinPathLength.description: Minimum length of the path before we will attempt to jump shortcut it
MinPathLength.label: Min Path Length

MinPeakPercent.description: How far along our travel distance should our peak occur at when at mininum range

MinPeakSpeed.description: Minimum velocity towards our target at min. WARNING: using this with MinInitialSpeed/MaxInitialSpeed can cause MinTime/MaxTime to be violated

MinPedestrianDistanceXZ.description: Birds will not spawn if a pedestrian is within this distance horizontally.
MinPedestrianDistanceXZ.label: Min Horizontal Pedestrian Distance

MinPedestrianDistanceY.description: Birds will not spawn if a pedestrian is within this distance vertically.
MinPedestrianDistanceY.label: Min Vertical Pedestrian Distance

MinPerceivedDistance.description: Clamps the distance to the target to a minimal value (happens before applying add/multiplier bias

MinPerceivedTargetDistance.description: This makes any target position we want to track perceived to be this far away. It helps solve goofiness that happens when the target point gets close to a limb and it over-aims

MinPercentOutOfView.description: Percent of our MaxAlive that out of the view frustum of the camera

MinPhase.description: What is the minimum phase number to use this combo. Starts from 0.
MinPhase.label: Min Phase

MinPitch.description: Low pitch means the camera is below the target, looking up at it.
MinPitch.label: Min Pitch (Absolute)

MinPlayerDistance.description: Crimes cannot spawn withing this distance of the player

MinPoisonRadius.description: This is the radius of the damage cylinder right when the poison starts to leak out.

MinPowerLevel.description: Bot must have at least this power level to use this set of mods. We'll use the mods from the highest matching power level.
MinPowerLevel.label: Min Power Level

MinPreRotateScreenRatio.description: Min Percentage from center to edge of screen to try and put the target

MinPromoteDist.description: Distance from the camera under which a pedestrian group will promote all of its members.

MinPromoteDistOffscreen.description: Distance from the camera under which a pedestrian group will promote all of its members when the group is offscreen.

MinPropagateDuration.description: When we are at a Level that uses AOE damage, this is the min duration the effect will last on a target

MinPullSpeed.description: Minimum speed the hero can travel at while being pulled

MinPushSpeed.description: How strongly we push at DistForMinPush

MinRPM.description: When at shift down speed for this gear, this is the RPM.

MinRadius.description: If CullBySize is set on the breakable, and the pool is full enough, the minimum radius of chunks to be spawned. If CullBySize is not set, or the pool is not full enough, this will be zero.
MinRadius.label: Min Radius

MinRageModePerfectDodgeWindowFrameCount.description: Overrides the standard perfect dodge window when Rage Mode is active ONLY IF the standard window is shorter than this (so it will never make easier difficulties harder). NOTE: Time is measured in frames at 30fps

MinRange.description: Minimum distance from our zip target

MinRangeXZ.description: If target horizontal distance is less than this value, SnapAngleAtMinRange is used. Otherwise, snap angle is blended towards SnapAngleAtMaxRange.

MinRateScale.description: The bot won't rate scale themself lower than this, even if it means the events aren't reached at the same time
MinRateScale.label: Min Rate Scale

MinRepositionDistance.description: Min distance that kraven can move while repositioning while obscured
MinRepositionDistance.label: Min Reposition Distance

MinRepositionDistanceFromHero.description: Min distance that kraven can be from the hero when repositioning while obscured
MinRepositionDistanceFromHero.label: Min Reposition Distance From Hero

MinReverbBlendDistanceScalar.description: Multiplied with Insideness to determine closest point to portal where both room's reverbs are fully present

MinRoadLengthNorth.description: The minimum length a road needs to extend north to be considered.

NearFadeClipDist.description: When the light's center is this distance from the camera, the light's intensity will be fully faded to zero. This can be set to a negative distance to make the light dim when you're close to it, but not fully disappear.
NearFadeClipDist.label: Near Fade Clip Dist

NearFadeDistance.description: Particles fade away when they are closer to the camera than this distance.

NearFadeInner.description: The light fades to 0 once it is this close

NearFadeOuter.description: Start fading the light if it is closer than this

NearFadeStart.description: The FX asset will start fading at "Near Fade Start" distance away from the camera
NearFadeStart.label: Near Fade Start

NearFadeStartDist.description: When the light's center is this distance from the camera, the light's intensity will start to fade down toward zero. A value of 0 (the default) disables near fading.
NearFadeStartDist.label: Near Fade Start Dist

NearLodDensityScalar.description:
Can be used to increase the vertex density/quality of smaller structures.
NOTE: Impostors cannot exceed 65k vertices, so this may have no effect on large or already dense Impostors.
WARNING: This can have a large impact on memory/performance if abused.
NearLodDensityScalar.label: Near Lod Density Scalar

NearScale.description: Scale factor on final deceleration when near attach point

NearTarget.description: Try to intercept near the target.

NearTargetGravity.description: When we get near the target, increase our gravity by this much

NearestPOI.description: If not None, enable this rule if given landmark type is the nearest POI and within DistToPOI meters. Ignored if None

NeedAmmo_AmmoFullWeightMod.description: Multiplies spawn weight of weapons that do NOT need ammo by this much ( only used if FavorWeaponsThatNeedAmmo )

NeedToFaceDestToExit.label: Need To Face Dest To Exit

NeedsJob.description: Is a job required for us to attack the target.

NeedsLandingSpace.description: If TRUE we will try and push targets away from where we think we're going to land

NeedsReveal.description: If true, the item must be revealed by Ganke Drones, and the reminder will be about the item picked, if false, the item has to be unrevealed, and the reminder will be to do drones

NeedsToHitHealthThreshold.description: If greater than 0.0f, this chunk will ONLY trigger for damage states with threshold below or at this number
NeedsToHitHealthThreshold.label: Needed Health Threshold

NeedsWaterImpulse.description: If this is checked (which it should be by default) then this bot needs to have a WaterImpulseGeneratorPrius and WaterHeightTriggerPrius on it so that it can make waves/ripples in the water. We will throw an error if the bot doesn't have these comps on them.

NegZOffset.description: How far behind the bot to do collision checks. Bot will only initiate QTE if there is enough room. Value should be > 0.

NegatedCondition.description: The Not returns the opposite value of this negated condition
NegatedCondition.label: Negated Condition

NeighborNodeScaleMultiplier.description: Original scale is multiplied by this number when a neighbor node is selected.

NeutralStickBiasAgainstMod.description: When neutral stick, these are multipliers applied to standard bias data that makes targets less likely. The thought process is that in neutral stick we are more willing to let the game decide whom to pick, so let's amp up any bias values that have been applied to favor bias even more

NeutralStickBiasForMod.description: When neutral stick, these are multipliers applied to standard bias data that makes targets more likely. The thought process is that in neutral stick we are more willing to let the game decide whom to pick, so let's amp up any bias values that have been applied to favor bias even more

NeutralStickSpeedPct.description: Max speed percent for neutral stick input

NeverCull.description: Never attempt to cull anim tree evaluates

NeverDecayFullStatus.description: If TRUE, once the Tracker applies the status effect it will never decay naturally.

NeverMakeCVC.description: If true, this Sandman instance will never make their own CVC cylinders unless manually scripted to do so. For background Sandmans that shouldn't ever push the player around from the outside of the interior setups
NeverMakeCVC.label: Never Make CVC

NewAttachJoint.description:
NOTE: Only use this if you know exactly what you are doing. This changes the hero's attach joint on the parent actor mid-animation.
That means at the time of transition, the old and new attach joints on the parent actor must be EXACTLY THE SAME. Otherwise there will be a pop, guaranteed.

NewDifficulty.description: The new base challenge level that is being applied for this segment
NewDifficulty.label: New Base Difficulty

NewStealthAwareness.label: New Stealth Awareness

NewTrendDirection.description: New temperature trend direction for this hot/cold target. Valid values: 'kGettingWarmer', 'kNotChanging', or 'kGettingColder'.

NoFlashBangToTargetCombos.description: List of combos where we should disable the Flash Bang To Target behavior.
NoFlashBangToTargetCombos.label: No Flash Bang To Target Combos

NoFocusCinematics.label: No Focus Cinematics

NoIgnore.description: Don't let target evade/dodge/ignore this attack

NoPickupTime.description: The amount of time the loot cannot be picked up.

NoStartDelay.description: Removes the delay added for the start music

NoTargetAntiMeleeButtonSpamTime.description: Max period after killing our target with melee button attacks in which we can potentially eat input if the next attack doesn't have a target.

NoTrucks.description: Random vehicle but without any large truck types.

NumCombosForLand.description: If nothing else triggers us to land, this is how many combos we'll do before landing.

NumSamplesVertical.description: Will use this number of samples in the y direction.

NumShots.description: This is how many shots you want to spawn. Min 1.

ShadowBrightening.description:
Limits the degree to which local tone mapping can brighten pixels.
A value of 0 prevents any increase in luminance. A value of 1 remove the brightening limit.
ShadowBrightening.label: Shadow Brightening

ShadowBrightness.description: It adds this value to control the overall shadow of clouds.

ShadowCacheHitCount.description: Number of caster submissions avoided due to shadow caching

ShadowCastType.description:
No Shadows: The light casts no shadows, no geometry will occlude this light.
Cache Static Models: Default behavior. When the light isn't animating, all static casters are cached for performance.
Only Static Models: Cheap option for placed lights. Static models will cast shadows but dynamic ones won't. On most frames no work needs to be done to render the shadow map.
Only Dynamic Models: Useful for optimizing cinematic lighting when you only care about the shadows from the actors in the shot.
ShadowCastType.label: Shadow Cast Type

ShadowCastingDistance.description: Controls how far away from the camera this emitter can cast a shadow. A value of zero means no shadow casting
ShadowCastingDistance.label: Shadow Casting Distance

ShadowCutOnDist.description: The distance along the light's forward axis where shadow casters will begin to render. Objects closer than this distance will not cast shadows. This can be used to skip objects close to the light source that would cause problematic shadowing.
ShadowCutOnDist.label: Shadow CutOn Dist

ShadowFadeDist.description: Distance beyond which the model no longer casts shadows (0 = no fade)
ShadowFadeDist.label: Shadow Fade Out Dist

ShadowFadeOutDist.description: If non-zero, this value is used in place of the main Shadow Fade Out Dist when the game is in Performance Mode.
ShadowFadeOutDist.label: Shadow Fade Out Dist

ShadowInnerCoverage.description: When set less than 1, only the inner region of the light is shadowed corresponding to the specified coverage amount. If 0.6 is specified, then the inner 60% of the light is shadowed and the outer 40% is not. This can be used as an optimization to reduce the shadow map generation cost, or as a way to concentrate shadow resolution where it is most important.
ShadowInnerCoverage.label: Shadow Inner Coverage

ShadowLodBias.description: Larger values increases the amount of lod reduction for shadow maps.
ShadowLodBias.label: Shadow Lod Bias

ShadowMeshStartLevel.description: This is the triangle density level at which the shadow mesh will start.

ShadowMicros.description: Wall clock time (1000 per millisecond) for the following GPU layers: kCreateShadowMaps and kCreateCSM.

ShadowPlatforms.description: Target specific platforms and/or frame rates for shadow casting
ShadowPlatforms.label: Shadow Activation Per Platform

ShadowRes.description:
Optimization: Higher resolutions gain detail, however have a higher fill-rate performance cost. Regardless of the setting, shadow res reduces further into the distance. If this setting is insufficient, check the following:
Scene Light Count If there are more shadowing lights than memory can bear, all shadows will be downres'ed until all fit.
Light Angle A shadow map must cover the entirety of the lit area, so wide angles on spot lights, or point lights that affect a great area will see their effective shadow resolution decrease as it's spread thinner over a greater area.
Note: Point lights actually generate 6 shadow maps, one for each cardinal axis direction/face of a cube, so they are 6x the cost of a spot light in terms of shadow cost.
ShadowRes.label: Shadow Resolution

ShadowSoftness.description: Sets a minimum penumbra size for key light shadows. Penumbra may be larger if the CSM doesn't have enough resolution.
ShadowSoftness.label: Shadow Softness

ShadowStaticOnlyDist.description: If non-zero, this value is used in place of the main Shadow Static-Only Dist when the game is in Performance Mode.

ShadowTiling.description: Scales the size ratio which shadows are rendered.
